literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 移植后 1、3 和 5 年,HBV 阳性和 HBV 阴性肾脏受者之间的同种异体移植存活风险比没有统计学差异,汇总估计值分别为 1 [0.98–1.01]、1.01 [0.98–1.04] 和 1.00 [0.91–1.09]。两组患者的生存率也相当。HBV 传播 的发生率较低,为 4.94%,特别是在使用预防措施以及受者在移植前进行免疫时。HBV 感染供体的肾脏与 HBV 阴性供体的肾脏具有相似的患者和同种异体移植存活率,可用于扩大供体库,特别是在适当预防的免疫 KTR 中。 [10.1111/ctr.70733]
抗病毒药物 核苷(酸)类似物治疗可改善 HBV 相关 HCC 的长期生存率。与未经治疗的患者相比,接受治疗的患者具有更高的 3 年和 5 年总生存 (OS) 率。然而,抗病毒药物 疗法目前在美国还不是 HCC 的 治疗 标准,其在临床实践中的使用情况仍然报道不足。 [10.1111/jvh.70245]

与连续治疗相比,有限疗程的NA治疗可能增加HBsAg丢失的概率,尽管证据确定性较低。研究发现,停药与HBsAg丢失的风险比为5.02(95% CI:0.47-53.47),相当于每1000名患者约有53例额外的HBsAg丢失。然而,有限疗程显著增加了病毒学复发(RR 23.09)和再次治疗(RR 21.94)的风险,同时降低了持续停药后的病毒学应答率(RR 0.46)。未报告肝功能失代偿或严重不良事件。 [10.1111/jvh.70243]
该平台在所有目标上均显示出可比的 log 10 VL 和可接受的精度。方差分析显示 HBV 和 HCV 没有显着差异,而 HIV 的 VL 值有显着差异。一致性分析确定了平台比较中的恒定偏差、比例偏差和变异性。 [10.1111/vox.70407]
经过7年零2个月的治疗治疗,患者的肝功能恢复正常,HBV DNA检测不到,FibroScan降至5.1 kPa。值得注意的是,患者的 HBsAg 消失且 Pre-S1 抗原呈阴性。截至 2025 年的长期随访一致显示 HBsAg 持续阴性(< 0.05 IU/ml)和无法检测到的高度敏感的 HBV DNA。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11579408/v1]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: At 1, 3, and 5 years post-transplant, the risk ratio for allograft survival was not statistically different between recipients of HBV positive and HBV negative kidneys, with pooled estimates of 1 [0.98–1.01], 1.01 [0.98–1.04], and 1.00 [0.91–1.09] respectively. [10.1111/ctr.70733]

Antiviral therapy with nucleos(t)ide analogues is associated with improved long-term survival in HBV-related HCC. Treated patients had higher 3- and 5-year overall survival (OS) rates compared to untreated patients. [10.1111/jvh.70245]
Finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss compared to continuous therapy, although the evidence is of low certainty. [10.1111/jvh.70243]

The platforms showed comparable log 10 VL and acceptable precision across all targets. ANOVA showed no significant differences for HBV and HCV, while HIV showed a significant difference in VL values. Agreement analyses identified constant bias, proportional bias and variability in platform comparisons. [10.1111/vox.70407]

After 7 years and 2 months of treatment, the patient's liver function normalized, HBV DNA became undetectable, and FibroScan decreased to 5.1 kPa. Notably, the patient achieved HBsAg loss and Pre-S1 antigen negativity. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11579408/v1]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。

移植后 1、3 和 5 年,HBV 阳性和 HBV 阴性肾脏受者之间的同种异体移植存活风险比没有统计学差异,汇总估计值分别为 1 [0.98–1.01]、1.01 [0.98–1.04] 和 1.00 [0.91–1.09]。两组患者的生存率也相当。HBV 传播 的发生率较低,为 4.94%,特别是在使用预防措施以及受者在移植前进行免疫时。HBV 感染供体的肾脏与 HBV 阴性供体的肾脏具有相似的患者和同种异体移植存活率,可用于扩大供体库,特别是在适当预防的免疫 KTR 中。
抗病毒药物 核苷(酸)类似物治疗可改善 HBV 相关 HCC 的长期生存率。与未经治疗的患者相比,接受治疗的患者具有更高的 3 年和 5 年总生存 (OS) 率。然而,抗病毒药物 疗法目前在美国还不是 HCC 的 治疗 标准,其在临床实践中的使用情况仍然报道不足。

与连续治疗相比,有限疗程的NA治疗可能增加HBsAg丢失的概率,尽管证据确定性较低。研究发现,停药与HBsAg丢失的风险比为5.02(95% CI:0.47-53.47),相当于每1000名患者约有53例额外的HBsAg丢失。然而,有限疗程显著增加了病毒学复发(RR 23.09)和再次治疗(RR 21.94)的风险,同时降低了持续停药后的病毒学应答率(RR 0.46)。未报告肝功能失代偿或严重不良事件。
该平台在所有目标上均显示出可比的 log 10 VL 和可接受的精度。方差分析显示 HBV 和 HCV 没有显着差异,而 HIV 的 VL 值有显着差异。一致性分析确定了平台比较中的恒定偏差、比例偏差和变异性。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.

At 1, 3, and 5 years post-transplant, the risk ratio for allograft survival was not statistically different between recipients of HBV positive and HBV negative kidneys, with pooled estimates of 1 [0.98–1.01], 1.01 [0.98–1.04], and 1.00 [0.91–1.09] respectively.

Antiviral therapy with nucleos(t)ide analogues is associated with improved long-term survival in HBV-related HCC. Treated patients had higher 3- and 5-year overall survival (OS) rates compared to untreated patients.
Finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss compared to continuous therapy, although the evidence is of low certainty. [10.1111/jvh.70243].
The platforms showed comparable log 10 VL and acceptable precision across all targets. ANOVA showed no significant differences for HBV and HCV, while HIV showed a significant difference in VL values.

news.headline_zh: FDA批准首个功能性治愈慢性乙型肝炎药物。
news.lead_zh: FDA于2026年11月5日批准贝匹罗韦森(Hibsago)作为首个功能性治愈慢性乙型肝炎的药物,基于3期临床试验结果。
key_findings_zh: FDA批准贝匹罗韦森用于治疗慢性乙型肝炎,适用于无肝硬化且接受核苷类似物治疗的患者。
3期试验显示,19%的患者在治疗后达到功能性治愈,而安慰剂组为0%。
药物通过每周注射给药,可与现有治疗结合,部分患者可停药。
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 功能性治愈药物的批准标志着慢性乙型肝炎治疗的重大进展,但长期效果仍需进一步验证。
news.caveats_zh: 部分患者可能出现严重副作用,如肝炎,需定期监测。
news.headline_en: FDA Approves First Drug Offering a 'Functional Cure' for Chronic Hepatitis B.
news.lead_en: On November 5, 2026, the FDA approved bepirovirsen (Hibsago) as the first drug offering a 'functional cure' for chronic hepatitis B, based on phase 3 trial results.
key_findings_en: The FDA approved bepirovirsen for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B in adults without cirrhosis who are on nucleoside analog therapy.
Phase 3 trials showed a 19% functional cure rate in patients with HBsAg levels at or below 3,000 IU/mL, compared to 0% in the placebo group.
The drug is administered via weekly injections and can be used alongside existing treatments, allowing some patients to discontinue pills.
news.trend_or_risk_en: The approval of a functional cure drug represents a significant advancement in managing chronic hepatitis B, but long-term effectiveness remains unproven.
news.caveats_en: Some patients experienced serious side effects, including liver inflammation, requiring regular monitoring.
news.brief_en: The FDA approved bepirovirsen (Hibsago) as the first drug offering a 'functional cure' for chronic hepatitis B, based on phase 3 trial results. The drug suppresses the virus to undetectable levels in some patients and can be used alongside existing treatments. However, long-term effectiveness is not yet proven, and some patients experienced serious side effects.

papers.title: Global Underutilization of Antiviral Therapy and Survival Outcomes in Hepatitis B Virus-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 78 Studies and 68,243 Patients.
papers.abstract: Antiviral therapy with nucleos(t)ide analogues is recommended for patients with viremic hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related cirrhosis regardless of levels of viremia or liver enzymes. However, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is not an antiviral treatment criterion in the U.S. HBV treatment guidelines, though prior studies have reported improved survival with antiviral treatment in HBV-related HCC. To inform guidelines, we estimated antiviral treatment rates and their association with survival and HCC recurrence rates in HBV-related HCC. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published between 2006 and 2024 that reported antiviral treatment, survival, and/or HCC recurrence rates in adults with HBV-related HCC, following PRISMA guidelines. Random-effects models pooled study estimates. Of the initial 4556 studies, 178 underwent full-text review, and 78 (68,243 patients) were analysed. The pooled antiviral treatment rate (52 studies, 41,345 patients) was 53.1%. In studies reporting pre-HCC antiviral initiation, 17.2% of HBV-related HCC patients received therapy before diagnosis. Treated (vs untreated) patients had higher 3- and 5-year OS (80.4% vs. 46.8%, both p < 0.01). Five-year OS was 78.0% vs. 56.4% in inactive HCC (p < 0.01) and 48.2% vs. 22.6% in active HCC (p = 0.14). Antiviral therapy remained independently associated with improved 5-year OS in multivariable meta-regression. There was no significant difference in HCC recurrence rates. Antiviral therapy is associated with improved long-term survival but remains underutilized in HBV-related HCC. These findings highlight a critical gap in care and underscore the need for earlier and more consistent antiviral initiation in patients with HBV-related HCC.

papers.title_original: Global Underutilization of Antiviral Therapy and Survival Outcomes in Hepatitis B Virus-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 78 Studies and 68,243 Patients.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the global underutilization of antiviral therapy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and its impact on survival outcomes. The central question is whether antiviral therapy improves survival in HBV-related HCC and how its utilization compares across different populations.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis and meta-analysis of 78 studies involving 68,243 patients, published between 2006 and 2024. The studies were selected following PRISMA guidelines, and random-effects models were used to pool study estimates. The review included studies that reported antiviral treatment, survival, and/or HCC recurrence rates in adults with HBV-related HCC.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Antiviral therapy with nucleos(t)ide analogues is associated with improved long-term survival in HBV-related HCC. Treated patients had higher 3- and 5-year overall survival (OS) rates compared to untreated patients. However, antiviral therapy is not currently a treatment criterion for HCC in the U.S., and its utilization remains underreported in clinical practice.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is no significant difference in HCC recurrence rates between treated and untreated patients. Additionally, the review highlights a critical gap in care, as antiviral therapy is underutilized despite its potential benefits. The evidence also suggests that the association between antiviral therapy and survival may vary depending on the activity of HCC.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: To improve patient outcomes, there is a need for earlier and more consistent antiviral initiation in patients with HBV-related HCC. The findings emphasize the importance of revising current treatment guidelines to include antiviral therapy as a criterion for managing HBV-related HCC, particularly in populations where it is currently underutilized.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 78 studies involving 68,243 patients assesses the role of antiviral therapy in improving survival outcomes for individuals with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The review finds that antiviral treatment is associated with higher 3- and 5-year overall survival rates compared to untreated patients. However, antiviral therapy is not currently a standard treatment criterion for HCC in the U.S., and its use remains underreported. The study highlights a critical gap in care and underscores the need for earlier and more consistent antiviral initiation in HBV-related HCC. Despite these findings, there is no significant difference in HCC recurrence rates between treated and untreated groups, suggesting further research is needed to understand the full impact of antiviral therapy in this context.

papers.title_zh: 全球抗病毒药物疗法在乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)相关肝细胞癌中的应用不足及其生存结局:一项纳入78项研究和68,243例患者的系统综述和荟萃分析。
papers.source_body_en: Antiviral therapy with nucleos(t)ide analogues is recommended for patients with viremic hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related cirrhosis regardless of levels of viremia or liver enzymes. However, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is not an antiviral treatment criterion in the U.S. HBV treatment guidelines, though prior studies have reported improved survival with antiviral treatment in HBV-related HCC. To inform guidelines, we estimated antiviral treatment rates and their association with survival and HCC recurrence rates in HBV-related HCC. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published between 2006 and 2024 that reported antiviral treatment, survival, and/or HCC recurrence rates in adults with HBV-related HCC, following PRISMA guidelines. Random-effects models pooled study estimates. Of the initial 4556 studies, 178 underwent full-text review, and 78 (68,243 patients) were analysed. The pooled antiviral treatment rate (52 studies, 41,345 patients) was 53.1%. In studies reporting pre-HCC antiviral initiation, 17.2% of HBV-related HCC patients received therapy before diagnosis. Treated (vs untreated) patients had higher 3- and 5-year OS (80.4% vs. 46.8%, both p < 0.01). Five-year OS was 78.0% vs. 56.4% in inactive HCC (p < 0.01) and 48.2% vs. 22.6% in active HCC (p = 0.14). Antiviral therapy remained independently associated with improved 5-year OS in multivariable meta-regression. There was no significant difference in HCC recurrence rates. Antiviral therapy is associated with improved long-term survival but remains underutilized in HBV-related HCC. These findings highlight a critical gap in care and underscore the need for earlier and more consistent antiviral initiation in patients with HBV-related HCC.
papers.abstract_zh: 使用核苷(酸)类似物进行抗病毒药物治疗被推荐用于所有具有病毒血症的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)相关肝硬化的患者,无论其病毒载量或肝酶水平如何。然而,肝细胞癌(HCC)并不是美国HBV 治疗指南中的治疗标准。尽管之前的研究报告指出,在HBV相关HCC患者中,抗病毒药物治疗与改善生存率相关,但目前仍缺乏明确的指南。为了指导指南制定,我们估计了抗病毒药物治疗率及其与生存率和HCC复发率之间的关联。我们按照PRISMA指南,对2006年至2024年间发表的、报告了HBV相关HCC成人患者抗病毒药物治疗率、生存率和/或HCC复发率的研究进行了系统综述和荟萃分析。使用随机效应模型汇总研究估计值。初始共有4556项研究,其中178项进行了全文审查,最终分析了78项(共68,243名患者)。汇总的抗病毒药物治疗率(52项研究,41,345名患者)为53.1%。在报告了HCC前抗病毒药物治疗启动的研究中,17.2%的HBV相关HCC患者在HCC发生前接受了治疗。接受治疗(与未接受治疗相比)的患者3年和5年总生存率(OS)更高(80.4% vs. 46.8%,两者p < 0.01)。在非活动性HCC研究中,5年OS为78.0% vs. 56.4%(p < 0.01),而在活动性HCC研究中,5年OS为48.2% vs. 22.6%(p = 0.14)。在多变量荟萃回归分析中,抗病毒药物治疗仍与改善5年OS独立相关。HCC复发率没有显著差异。抗病毒药物治疗与改善长期生存率相关,但在HBV相关HCC中仍被低估使用。这些发现突显了护理中的关键差距,并强调了在HBV相关HCC患者中更早和更一致地启动抗病毒药物治疗的必要性。

papers.title: Safety, Tolerability and Antiviral Activity of GST-HG131 in Chronic Hepatitis B: A Randomized, Double-Blind Phase IIa Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global health burden. Current therapies rarely achieve a functional cure due to low rates of HBsAg clearance, the persistence of the viral replication template-covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA)-and the need for lifelong treatment. GST-HG131 is a first-in-class, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of PAPD5/7, key host factors involved in HBV mRNA stabilization and HBsAg production. We evaluated the safety, tolerability and antiviral activity of GST-HG131 in patients with CHB receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NUC) therapy in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase IIa study. METHODS: This double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled Phase IIa study evaluated the efficacy and safety of GST-HG131 in 45 CHB patients. Cohorts 1 and 2 (n = 10 each; 8 active, 2 placebo) received 30 mg or 60 mg BID for 28 days, respectively. Cohort 3 (n = 25; 20 active, five placebo) received 30 mg BID for 12 weeks. All participants were on nucleos(t)ide analog monotherapy for more than 6 months, with HBsAg between 100 and 1500 IU/mL, and serum ALT below 1× ULN. RESULTS: At Day 28, HBsAg reductions were -0.65 log10 IU/mL in the 30 mg BID 28-day group and -0.53 log10 IU/mL in the 60 mg BID 28-day group. The 30 mg BID 12-week group showed a greater reduction of -0.89 log10 IU/mL at the end of treatment versus placebo (p 50% reduction in HBsAg with a maximum decrease of 1.64 log10 IU/mL. Notably, 76.5% of patients in the 12-week group achieved HBsAg below 100 IU/mL. Rebounds in HBsAg were observed following treatment discontinuation. GST-HG131 was well tolerated, with no dose-related toxicity or emerging safety concerns across all cohorts. CONCLUSION: GST-HG131, a first-in-class oral PAPD5/7 inhibitor, demonstrated favourable safety and significant HBsAg reduction in patients with CHB. The greatest antiviral activity was observed after 12 weeks of treatment, supporting further clinical development of GST-HG131 as a component of functional cure strategies for CHB. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06263959.

source_records.title: Safety, Tolerability and Antiviral Activity of GST-HG131 in Chronic Hepatitis B: A Randomized, Double-Blind Phase IIa Study.
source_records.abstract: Background and aims Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global health burden. Current therapies rarely achieve a functional cure due to low rates of HBsAg clearance, the persistence of the viral replication template-covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA)-and the need for lifelong treatment. GST-HG131 is a first-in-class, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of PAPD5/7, key host factors involved in HBV mRNA stabilization and HBsAg production. We evaluated the safety, tolerability and antiviral activity of GST-HG131 in patients with CHB receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NUC) therapy in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase IIa study. Methods This double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled Phase IIa study evaluated the efficacy and safety of GST-HG131 in 45 CHB patients. Cohorts 1 and 2 (n = 10 each; 8 active, 2 placebo) received 30 mg or 60 mg BID for 28 days, respectively. Cohort 3 (n = 25; 20 active, five placebo) received 30 mg BID for 12 weeks. All participants were on nucleos(t)ide analog monotherapy for more than 6 months, with HBsAg between 100 and 1500 IU/mL, and serum ALT below 1× ULN. Results At Day 28, HBsAg reductions were -0.65 log 10 IU/mL in the 30 mg BID 28-day group and -0.53 log 10 IU/mL in the 60 mg BID 28-day group. Notably, 76.5% of patients in the 12-week group achieved HBsAg below 100 IU/mL. Rebounds in HBsAg were observed following treatment discontinuation. GST-HG131 was well tolerated, with no dose-related toxicity or emerging safety concerns across all cohorts. Conclusion GST-HG131, a first-in-class oral PAPD5/7 inhibitor, demonstrated favourable safety and significant HBsAg reduction in patients with CHB. The greatest antiviral activity was observed after 12 weeks of treatment, supporting further clinical development of GST-HG131 as a component of functional cure strategies for CHB. papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目标:慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然是全球主要的健康负担。由于 HBsAg 清除率低、病毒复制模板(共价闭合环状 DNA (共价闭合环状DNA))的持续存在以及终生 治疗 的需要,目前的疗法很少实现 功能性治愈。GST-HG131 是一种一流的口服生物可利用的 PAPD5/7 小分子抑制剂,PAPD5/7 是参与 HBV mRNA 稳定和 HBsAg 产生的关键 宿主 因子。我们在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照 IIa 期研究中评估了 GST-HG131 在接受核苷(酸)类似物(NUC)治疗的 CHB 患者中的安全性、耐受性和 抗病毒药物 活性。方法:这项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照 IIa 期研究评估了 GST-HG131 在 45 名慢性乙型肝炎患者中的疗效和安全性。队列研究 1 和 2(n = 10 名;8 名活性药物,2 名安慰剂)分别接受 30 mg 或 60 mg BID,持续 28 天。队列研究 3(n = 25;20 名活性药物,5 名安慰剂)接受 30 mg BID,为期 12 周。所有参与者均接受核苷(酸)类似物单药治疗超过 6 个月,HBsAg 介于 100 至 1500 IU/mL 之间,血清 ALT 低于 1×ULN。结果:第 28 天时,30 mg BID 28 天组的 HBsAg 减少量为 -0.65 log10 IU/mL,60 mg BID 28 天组的 HBsAg 减少量为 -0.53 log10 IU/mL。与安慰剂相比,30 mg BID 12 周组在 治疗 结束时显示出更大的降低 -0.89 log10 IU/mL(HBsAg 降低 50%,最大降低 1.64 log10 IU/mL。值得注意的是,12 周组中有 76.5% 的患者达到 HBsAg 低于 100 IU/mL。HBsAg 反弹在 治疗 停药后观察到,GST-HG131 的耐受性良好,所有 队列研究 均未出现剂量相关的毒性或新出现的安全性问题。治疗,支持 GST-HG131 的进一步临床开发,作为 CHB 的 功能性治愈 策略的组成部分。临床试验注册号:NCT06263959。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)仍然是全球主要的健康负担。由于HBsAg清除率低、病毒复制模板——共价闭合环状DNA(共价闭合环状DNA)的持续存在以及需要终身治疗,现有疗法很少能实现功能性治愈。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照的IIa期研究评估了GST-HG131在45名慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中的疗效和安全性。所有参与者均接受了超过6个月的核苷(酸)类似物单药治疗,HBsAg水平在100至1500 IU/mL之间,且血清ALT低于1× ULN。
analysis_zh.methods: 组1和组2(各10名患者;8名接受治疗,2名接受安慰剂)分别接受了30 mg或60 mg每日两次(BID)治疗28天。组3(25名患者;20名接受治疗,5名接受安慰剂)接受了30 mg BID治疗12周。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在第28天时,30 mg每日两次28天组的HBsAg水平降低了-0.65 log10 IU/mL,而60 mg每日两次28天组的HBsAg水平降低了-0.53 log10 IU/mL。在治疗结束时,12周组的HBsAg水平比安慰剂组减少了更多的-0.89 log10 IU/mL。值得注意的是,12周组中有76.5%的患者实现了HBsAg低于100 IU/mL。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在12周的治疗后观察到最大的功能性治愈活性,支持进一步开展GST-HG131在慢性乙型肝炎功能性治愈策略中的临床开发。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,GST-HG131可能是一种有前景的候选药物,有助于改善慢性乙型肝炎患者中HBsAg的清除,从而可能为功能性治愈策略做出贡献。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究样本量较小且治疗时间较短,这可能影响其结果的普遍性。由于研究设计和有限的随访时间,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Transplantation of Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Positive or Viremic Kidneys: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis examines the evidence related to the use of HBV positive kidneys into non-viremic kidney transplant recipients (KTRs). METHODS: We searched PubMed and Embase through November 2025 and identified studies of recipients of hepatitis B surface antigen positive (HBsAg+) or viremic kidneys. Studies with a comparison group of KTRs of HBV negative kidneys that reported on patient and allograft survivals were included in the meta-analysis. The risk ratios (RR) for patient and allograft survivals were pooled to obtain the estimate and 95% confidence interval, at 1-, 3-, and 5-years post-transplant. Viral transmission including HBsAg development, HBV viremia, or hepatitis was also reviewed. RESULTS: Eleven studies were included in the systematic review and 6 in the meta-analysis. They included 638 KTRs of HBV positive kidneys and 2800 recipients of HBsAg negative non viremic kidneys. At 1, 3, and 5 years, the RR of allograft survival was not statistically different between the 2 groups and was 1 [0.98-1.01], 1.01 [0.98-1.04], and 1.00 [0.91-1.09] respectively. Similarly, the RR of patient survival was comparable between the 2 groups. The rate of HBV transmission was low (4.94%), especially when prophylaxis was used and when recipients were immune pre transplant. CONCLUSION: Kidneys from HBV infected donors confer similar patient and allograft survival than those from HBV negative donors. They may be used to expand the donor pool, in immune KTRs and with appropriate prophylaxis, in light of this emerging evidence of safety with very low reported rates of transmission.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review examines whether kidneys from hepatitis B surface antigen-positive donors can be safely transplanted into non-viremic kidney transplant recipients, and whether such kidneys confer similar patient and allograft survival compared to HBV-negative donor kidneys. The central question concerns the safety and viability of HBV-positive donor kidneys in the context of current antiviral prophylaxis.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic review and meta-analysis that searched PubMed and Embase through November 2025. Eligibility criteria required studies comparing recipients of HBV positive versus HBV negative kidneys with reported patient and allograft survivals. Eleven studies were included in the systematic review and six in the meta-analysis. The meta-analysis pooled risk ratios for patient and allograft survival at 1-, 3-, and 5-years post-transplant, with 95% confidence intervals.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: At 1, 3, and 5 years post-transplant, the risk ratio for allograft survival was not statistically different between recipients of HBV positive and HBV negative kidneys, with pooled estimates of 1 [0.98–1.01], 1.01 [0.98–1.04], and 1.00 [0.91–1.09] respectively. Patient survival was also comparable between the two groups. The rate of HBV transmission was low at 4.94%, particularly when prophylaxis was used and when recipients were immune pre-transplant. Kidneys from HBV infected donors confer similar patient and allograft survival to those from HBV negative donors and may be used to expand the donor pool, especially in immune KTRs with appropriate prophylaxis.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence base includes only six studies in the meta-analysis, which may limit generalizability. The review did not report subgroup analyses by HBV genotype, donor viremia status, or specific prophylaxis regimens, leaving uncertainty about which donor or recipient factors drive any residual transmission risk. No data on long-term outcomes beyond five years were reported.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Kidneys from HBV infected donors can be considered for transplantation into appropriate recipients with antiviral prophylaxis, expanding the donor pool. Future research should evaluate longer-term outcomes, HBV genotype-specific effects, and optimal prophylaxis strategies to further reduce transmission risk.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis assessed whether HBV-positive donor kidneys confer similar patient and allograft survival as HBV-negative donor kidneys in kidney transplant recipients. Pooled risk ratios for allograft survival at 1-, 3-, and 5-years were 1 [0.98–1.01], 1.01 [0.98–1.04], and 1.00 [0.91–1.09], respectively, indicating no statistically significant difference. Patient survival was also comparable between the two groups. HBV transmission occurred at a low rate of 4.94%, especially with prophylaxis and immune pre-transplant status. The authors conclude that HBV-positive kidneys may safely expand the donor pool, particularly in immune KTRs with appropriate prophylaxis.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述探讨了乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性供体的肾脏是否可以安全地移植到非病毒血症肾移植受者体内,以及与乙型肝炎病毒阴性供体肾脏相比,此类肾脏是否具有相似的患者和同种异体移植物存活率。核心问题涉及当前 抗病毒药物 预防背景下 HBV 阳性供体肾脏的安全性和生存能力。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是一项系统综述和荟萃分析,检索了截至 2025 年 11 月的 PubMed 和 Embase。资格标准要求进行研究,对 HBV 阳性和 HBV 阴性肾脏的受者与报告的患者和同种异体移植物的存活率进行比较。系统评价纳入了 11 项研究,荟萃分析纳入了 6 项研究。荟萃分析汇总了移植后 1 年、3 年和 5 年患者和同种异体移植物存活的风险比,置信区间为 95%。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 移植后 1、3 和 5 年,HBV 阳性和 HBV 阴性肾脏受者之间的同种异体移植存活风险比没有统计学差异,汇总估计值分别为 1 [0.98–1.01]、1.01 [0.98–1.04] 和 1.00 [0.91–1.09]。两组患者的生存率也相当。HBV 传播 的发生率较低,为 4.94%,特别是在使用预防措施以及受者在移植前进行免疫时。HBV 感染供体的肾脏与 HBV 阴性供体的肾脏具有相似的患者和同种异体移植存活率,可用于扩大供体库,特别是在适当预防的免疫 KTR 中。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 荟萃分析中的证据基础仅包括六项研究,这可能会限制普遍性。该综述没有报告按 HBV 基因型、供者病毒血症状态或具体预防方案进行的亚组分析,因此无法确定哪些供者或受者因素驱动任何残留的 传播 风险。没有报告五年以上长期结果的数据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 可以考虑将感染 HBV 的供体的肾脏移植到适当的受者体内,并进行 抗病毒药物 预防,从而扩大供体库。未来的研究应评估长期结果、HBV 基因型特异性效应和最佳预防策略,以进一步降低 传播 风险。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述探讨了乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性供体的肾脏是否可以安全地移植到非病毒血症肾移植受者体内,以及与乙型肝炎病毒阴性供体肾脏相比,此类肾脏是否具有相似的患者和同种异体移植物存活率。核心问题涉及当前 抗病毒药物 预防背景下 HBV 阳性供体肾脏的安全性和生存能力。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是一项系统综述和荟萃分析,检索了截至 2025 年 11 月的 PubMed 和 Embase。资格标准要求进行研究,对 HBV 阳性和 HBV 阴性肾脏的受者与报告的患者和同种异体移植物的存活率进行比较。系统评价纳入了 11 项研究,荟萃分析纳入了 6 项研究。荟萃分析汇总了移植后 1 年、3 年和 5 年患者和同种异体移植物存活的风险比,置信区间为 95%。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 移植后 1、3 和 5 年,HBV 阳性和 HBV 阴性肾脏受者之间的同种异体移植存活风险比没有统计学差异,汇总估计值分别为 1 [0.98–1.01]、1.01 [0.98–1.04] 和 1.00 [0.91–1.09]。两组患者的生存率也相当。HBV 传播 的发生率较低,为 4.94%,特别是在使用预防措施以及受者在移植前进行免疫时。HBV 感染供体的肾脏与 HBV 阴性供体的肾脏具有相似的患者和同种异体移植存活率,可用于扩大供体库,特别是在适当预防的免疫 KTR 中。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 荟萃分析中的证据基础仅包括六项研究,这可能会限制普遍性。该综述没有报告按 HBV 基因型、供者病毒血症状态或具体预防方案进行的亚组分析,因此无法确定哪些供者或受者因素驱动任何残留的 传播 风险。没有报告五年以上长期结果的数据。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 可以考虑将感染 HBV 的供体的肾脏移植到适当的受者体内,并进行 抗病毒药物 预防,从而扩大供体库。未来的研究应评估长期结果、HBV 基因型特异性效应和最佳预防策略,以进一步降低 传播 风险。

papers.title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of the PD-1 Inhibitor Cetrelimab in Chronic Hepatitis B.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-induced T-cell exhaustion may be reversed using a programmed death receptor 1 (PD-1) inhibitor such as cetrelimab, an investigational fully human monoclonal antibody targeting PD-1. To evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low-dose (i.e., a dose lower than that used in oncology) cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) virologically suppressed (VS) on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog (NA). Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-cohort, single-dose escalation study of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, and not to any safety concern, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their NA treatment to avoid HBV reactivation. Serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy (RO) and safety were collected over 24 weeks. Eleven participants were enrolled and randomized, eight to cetrelimab and three to placebo and all 11 completed the study. Mean cetrelimab half-life was 16.3 days with median time to maximum cetrelimab concentration 10.4 days post-dose. Near-maximal RO was achieved 6 h post-dose which waned over time. There were no clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values including liver function tests and thyroid-stimulating hormone. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported. A single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in VS participants with CHB was safe and well tolerated. There was no change in HBV biomarkers and further development of cetrelimab for HBV was abandoned. Clinical Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT05242445; EudraCT Number: 2021-004857-21.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that cetrelimab may not be effective in altering HBV biomarkers in virologically suppressed participants with chronic hepatitis B, which has implications for the development of PD-1 inhibitors as therapeutic agents for HBV.

The study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single-dose escalation trial, with only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) executed. Participants continued their nucleos(t)ide analog treatment to prevent HBV reactivation. The study collected data on cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy, and safety over 24 weeks. No clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or adverse events were observed, leading to the conclusion that cetrelimab was safe and well tolerated but showed no effect on HBV markers. The findings suggest that cetrelimab may not be effective for HBV treatment, resulting in the abandonment of its further development. The study's small sample size and short duration limit the confidence in the results, and the evidence strength is moderate.

papers.title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 中 PD-1 抑制剂 Cetrelimab 的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照研究。
papers.source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-induced T-cell exhaustion may be reversed using a programmed death receptor 1 (PD-1) inhibitor such as cetrelimab, an investigational fully human monoclonal antibody targeting PD-1. To evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low-dose (i.e., a dose lower than that used in oncology) cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) virologically suppressed (VS) on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog (NA). Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-cohort, single-dose escalation study of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, and not to any safety concern, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their NA treatment to avoid HBV reactivation. Serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy (RO) and safety were collected over 24 weeks. Eleven participants were enrolled and randomized, eight to cetrelimab and three to placebo and all 11 completed the study. Mean cetrelimab half-life was 16.3 days with median time to maximum cetrelimab concentration 10.4 days post-dose. Near-maximal RO was achieved 6 h post-dose which waned over time. There were no clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values including liver function tests and thyroid-stimulating hormone. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported. A single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in VS participants with CHB was safe and well tolerated. There was no change in HBV biomarkers and further development of cetrelimab for HBV was abandoned. Clinical Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT05242445; EudraCT Number: 2021-004857-21.

papers.title: Finite Versus Indefinite Nucleos(t)ide Analogue Therapy in HBeAg‐Negative Chronic Hepatitis B: Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Trials.
papers.abstract: Continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) effectively maintains viral suppression but rarely results in functional cure. Finite NA therapy has been proposed to increase rates of HBsAg loss; however, international guidelines provide conflicting recommendations. This study compares the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous NA therapy in HBeAg-negative adults using randomized controlled trials. We included parallel-group randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed HBeAg-negative adults. Two reviewers independently screened studies and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects Mantel-Haenszel meta-analyses with Hartung-Knapp adjustment and Paule-Mandel estimation were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE approach. Four RCTs (n = 357) met inclusion criteria. Discontinuation increased HBsAg loss vs. continuation (RR 5.02, 95% CI: 0.47-53.47; I 2 = 21.8%; low certainty), corresponding to ~53 additional losses per 1000 patients. However, finite therapy markedly increased virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94) while reducing sustained off-therapy virologic response (RR 0.46). Post-cessation ALT flares were frequent but self-limited or resolved with retreatment. No hepatic decompensation or serious adverse events occurred. In monitored, non-cirrhotic adults, finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss despite predictable relapse and retreatment. With no evidence of severe harm, these findings support finite therapy as a selective, patient-centered strategy toward functional cure in expert centers.

papers.title_original: Finite Versus Indefinite Nucleos(t)ide Analogue Therapy in HBeAg‐Negative Chronic Hepatitis B: Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Trials.

analysis.scope_and_question: This study investigates the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy in HBeAg-negative adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The central question is whether finite therapy increases the likelihood of HBsAg loss while maintaining viral suppression.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review includes four parallel-group randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing NA cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed HBeAg-negative adults. Two reviewers independently screened studies and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects Mantel-Haenszel meta-analyses with Hartung-Knapp adjustment and Paule-Mandel estimation were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Certainty of evidence was evaluated using the GRADE approach.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss compared to continuous therapy, although the evidence is of low certainty. The study found that discontinuation of therapy was associated with a risk ratio of 5.02 (95% CI: 0.47-53.47) for HBsAg loss, corresponding to approximately 53 additional losses per 1000 patients. However, finite therapy significantly increased virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94) while reducing sustained off-therapy virologic response (RR 0.46). No hepatic decompensation or serious adverse events were reported.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: International guidelines provide conflicting recommendations on finite versus continuous NA therapy. The evidence for HBsAg loss is of low certainty, and the wide confidence interval suggests uncertainty in the effect estimate. Additionally, the study does not address long-term outcomes or the impact of finite therapy on HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma or cirrhosis.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to clarify the long-term safety and efficacy of finite NA therapy, particularly in relation to HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma and cirrhosis. The findings suggest that finite therapy could be considered as a selective strategy in expert centers for achieving functional cure, but more data are required to support its broader implementation.

analysis.summary_en: This meta-analysis evaluates the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy in HBeAg-negative adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Four randomized controlled trials (RCTs) were included, comparing NA cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed patients. The study found that finite therapy may increase HBsAg loss, with a risk ratio of 5.02 (95% CI: 0.47-53.47), but also significantly raises the risk of virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94). Sustained off-therapy virologic response was reduced (RR 0.46). No serious adverse events were reported. The evidence is of low certainty, and international guidelines remain conflicting. These findings support finite therapy as a potential strategy for functional cure in expert settings, but further research is needed to address long-term outcomes and confirm its safety and efficacy across different disease manifestations.

papers.title_zh: HBeAg阴性慢性乙型肝炎中有限与无限核苷(酸)类似物治疗的对比:随机试验的荟萃分析
papers.source_body_en: Continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) effectively maintains viral suppression but rarely results in functional cure. Finite NA therapy has been proposed to increase rates of HBsAg loss; however, international guidelines provide conflicting recommendations. This study compares the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous NA therapy in HBeAg-negative adults using randomized controlled trials. We included parallel-group randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed HBeAg-negative adults. Two reviewers independently screened studies and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects Mantel-Haenszel meta-analyses with Hartung-Knapp adjustment and Paule-Mandel estimation were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE approach. Four RCTs (n = 357) met inclusion criteria. Discontinuation increased HBsAg loss vs. continuation (RR 5.02, 95% CI: 0.47-53.47; I 2 = 21.8%; low certainty), corresponding to ~53 additional losses per 1000 patients. However, finite therapy markedly increased virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94) while reducing sustained off-therapy virologic response (RR 0.46). Post-cessation ALT flares were frequent but self-limited or resolved with retreatment. No hepatic decompensation or serious adverse events occurred. In monitored, non-cirrhotic adults, finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss despite predictable relapse and retreatment. With no evidence of severe harm, these findings support finite therapy as a selective, patient-centered strategy toward functional cure in expert centers.

papers.title: Chronic Hepatitis B in the United States: Current Landscape, Unmet Needs and Future Directions
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection represents a major public health challenge in the US, with substantial unmet needs related to timely diagnosis, treatment, monitoring and disease management. This narrative review explores the CHB landscape in the US, including gaps in patient care, the evolving therapeutic landscape, the clinical utility of serological biomarkers to improve outcomes and the experiences of people living with hepatitis B (PLWHB). Hepatitis B remains underdiagnosed and undertreated in the US, and current efforts are insufficient to meet the associated World Health Organization 2030 elimination targets. Latest guidelines from the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the Infectious Diseases Society of America, representing a North American perspective, signify a shift towards expanded treatment eligibility criteria and shared decision‐making. Nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) are the current standard of care in the US, but functional cure is rarely achieved with NAs alone. Novel finite therapies targeting functional cure, such as antisense oligonucleotides, small interfering RNAs, immune modulators and combination or sequential regimens, are under investigation. Because of the unpredictable, complex nature of CHB, biomarkers such as quantitative hepatitis B surface antigen offer prognostic value for treatment decisions and could help guide individualised CHB management. PLWHB experience psychological impacts and health‐related concerns, including fear of transmission and hepatitis B virus‐related complications. Opportunities for improvement of CHB management include increased screening and linkage to care, development of more treatments targeting functional cure, adoption of serological biomarkers to inform treatment decisions and prioritising the lived experiences and preferences of PLWHB.

analysis.summary_en: This review highlights the challenges of managing chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in the United States, emphasizing the need for improved diagnosis, treatment, and patient care. It outlines the current standard of care, which involves nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs), but notes that these rarely achieve a functional cure. The review identifies gaps in the management of CHB, including the lack of effective therapies and the underutilization of serological biomarkers. It also underscores the importance of incorporating the lived experiences and preferences of people living with hepatitis B (PLWHB) into treatment decisions. The review calls for expanded treatment eligibility criteria and shared decision-making, as reflected in the latest guidelines from the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the Infectious Diseases Society of America. Despite these efforts, current strategies are insufficient to meet the World Health Organization's 2030 elimination targets, indicating a need for further research and innovation in CHB management.

papers.title: Similar Long-Term Incidence of Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Chronic Hepatitis B Initiating Entecavir Versus Tenofovir Alafenamide: A REAL-B Study.
papers.abstract: Data on potential differences in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence between entecavir (ETV) and tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients are limited. This retrospective multinational study included treatment-naïve adults with CHB without a history of HCC who initiated ETV or TAF therapy since 2016 at 23 centres in 4 countries. Baseline characteristics were balanced using inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) and propensity score matching (PSM). HCC incidence and the association between antiviral regimen and HCC were analysed using competing-risk analysis. A total of 1437 patients (710 ETV, 727 TAF) were included, with similar mean follow-up durations (55.5 ± 29.8 vs. 58.0 ± 25.5 months; p = 0.077). ETV-treated patients were older, more frequently male, and more likely to have cirrhosis. After IPTW, both groups had balanced characteristics (all standardised differences < 0.1). After IPTW adjustment, during follow-up, 23 patients on ETV and 20 on TAF developed HCC, with incidence rates of 0.67 and 0.65 per 100 person-years, respectively (p = 0.853). There was no statistically significant difference in HCC risk between the groups (SHR: 1.09; 95% CI: 0.44-2.65; p = 0.851), with consistent findings across subgroups by age, sex, cirrhosis, hepatic steatosis, HBeAg, baseline liver enzymes, HBV DNA levels, diabetes mellitus and in sensitivity analysis using PSM. In this real-world multinational study of treatment-naïve CHB patients, HCC incidence did not significantly differ between ETV and TAF groups, suggesting therapeutic selection should consider cost and patient-specific factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the long-term incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients initiating entecavir (ETV) or tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) therapy. A retrospective multinational study was conducted involving 1437 treatment-naïve adults with CHB without prior HCC, recruited from 23 centres across four countries between 2016 and the study's end date. Baseline characteristics were balanced using inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) and propensity score matching (PSM). The study found that 23 patients on ETV and 20 on TAF developed HCC during follow-up, with incidence rates of 0.67 and 0.65 per 100 person-years, respectively. After IPTW adjustment, there was no statistically significant difference in HCC risk between the groups, with consistent findings across various subgroups. The results suggest that therapeutic selection should consider cost and patient-specific factors rather than HCC risk. However, the study noted that ETV-treated patients were older, more frequently male, and more likely to have cirrhosis, which may introduce potential confounding factors. The evidence is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and the possibility of residual confounding.

papers.abstract_zh: 关于恩替卡韦(ETV)和替诺福韦艾拉酚胺(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中对肝细胞癌(HCC)发病率潜在差异的数据有限。本回顾性多国研究纳入了2016年以来在4个国家的23个中心开始接受ETV或TAF治疗的、无HCC病史且未接受过抗病毒药物治疗的CHB成人患者。使用逆概率加权(IPTW)和倾向评分匹配(PSM)方法平衡基线特征。采用竞争风险分析方法分析HCC发病率及抗病毒治疗方案与HCC之间的关联。共纳入1437名患者(ETV组710名,TAF组727名),其平均随访时间相似(ETV组55.5 ± 29.8个月 vs. TAF组58.0 ± 25.5个月;p = 0.077)。接受ETV治疗的患者年龄更大,男性比例更高,且更可能患有肝硬化。在IPTW调整后,两组患者的特征趋于平衡(所有标准化差异均<0.1)。调整后随访期间,ETV组有23例患者和TAF组有20例患者发展为HCC,其HCC发病率分别为每100人年0.67和0.65(p = 0.853)。两组之间HCC风险无统计学显著差异(SHR:1.09;95% CI:0.44-2.65;p = 0.851),且在按年龄、性别、肝硬化、脂肪肝、HBeAg状态、基线肝酶水平、HBV DNA水平、糖尿病等亚组分析以及使用PSM进行敏感性分析中结果一致。在这一真实世界多国研究中,对于未接受过抗病毒治疗的CHB患者,ETV和TAF组的HCC发病率无显著差异,提示治疗选择应考虑成本和患者个体因素。

papers.title: Hepatitis B and D: Interferon‐Based Therapy—For Clinical Trials or Standard of Care—Back to the Future?
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Interferon (IFN) has historically played a major role in chronic viral hepatitis B and D management over the last three decades. Widening utilisation of nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) for hepatitis B viral suppression, which have a better side‐effect profile, alongside the recent licensing of bulevirtide for treatment of hepatitis D, means that its clinical use has further declined. Pegylated‐interferon alpha (peg‐IFNα) treatment is suboptimal with poor tolerability and achieves durable clearance of hepatitis B and D in only a limited number of patients. Nevertheless, its use in hepatitis B has significantly increased the number of patients achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss compared to those on NUCs alone. Evidence has shown that peg‐IFNα is also associated with overall improved long‐term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D, even for the many whose hepatitis D viral load rebounds after discontinuation. Clinical trials have recently focused on peg‐IFNα in combination with novel antiviral therapies in the goal for finite cure in hepatitis B and D. This article focuses on recent research advances, examining if peg‐IFNα treatment may still play an important role in hepatitis B and D treatment.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of interferon-based therapy in the treatment of hepatitis B and D, specifically examining its clinical use, effectiveness, and potential for future applications. The central question is whether pegylated-interferon alpha (peg-IFNα) treatment may still play an important role in managing these infections.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. It includes a general overview of the topic and highlights recent clinical trials and research advances.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that peg-IFNα is associated with improved long-term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D, even for patients whose viral load rebounds after treatment. It also notes that peg-IFNα has been shown to increase the number of patients achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss compared to nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) alone.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that peg-IFNα treatment is suboptimal due to poor tolerability and limited durable clearance of hepatitis B and D. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on combining peg-IFNα with novel antiviral therapies to achieve a finite cure for hepatitis B and D. It also implies that there is a need for further investigation into the long-term benefits and risks of peg-IFNα treatment.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the role of interferon-based therapy, particularly pegylated-interferon alpha (peg-IFNα), in the treatment of hepatitis B and D. It highlights that while peg-IFNα has been associated with improved long-term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D and increased HBsAg loss in hepatitis B compared to nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) alone, its use has declined due to poor tolerability and limited durable clearance. The review also notes the recent licensing of bulevirtide for hepatitis D and the increasing use of NUCs. It suggests that future research should explore combining peg-IFNα with novel antiviral therapies to achieve a finite cure for these infections.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 过去三十年来,干扰素 (IFN) 在慢性病毒性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的治疗中发挥了重要作用。核苷/核苷酸类似物(NUC)在抑制乙型肝炎病毒方面的广泛应用,其副作用较小,加上最近获得了用于丁型肝炎 治疗 的 bulevirtide 许可,意味着其临床使用进一步下降。聚乙二醇化干扰素α (peg-IFNα) 治疗 效果欠佳,耐受性较差,仅在有限数量的患者中实现了乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的持久清除。尽管如此,与单独使用 NUC 的患者相比,其在乙型肝炎中的使用显着增加了实现乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 消失的患者数量。有证据表明,peg-IFNα 还与慢性丁型肝炎的长期临床结局的整体改善相关,即使对于许多丁型肝炎病毒载量在停药后反弹的人来说也是如此。最近的临床试验重点关注 peg-IFNα 与新型 抗病毒药物 疗法的联合治疗,以实现乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的有限治愈。本文重点介绍最新的研究进展,探讨 peg-IFNα 治疗 是否仍可能在乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎 治疗 中发挥重要作用。

papers.title: A comparative viral load evaluation for human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis B virus and hepatitis C virus of the Roche cobas 5800, Abbott Alinity m and Hologic Panther
papers.abstract: Abstract Background and Objectives Viral load (VL) quantification for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) is essential for clinical monitoring, treatment response assessment and post‐donation interpretation. With the introduction of automated molecular platforms, comparative evaluations are required to assess inter‐platform agreement, bias and precision across the quantitative VL range. Materials and Methods A comparative study was conducted using 280 plasma samples from blood donors. VL measurements were performed using the Roche cobas 5800 system, Abbott Alinity m system and the relevant Aptima quantitative assays on the Hologic Panther system. Agreement between platforms was assessed using Deming regression, Passing–Bablok regression, Lin's concordance correlation coefficient and Bland–Altman analyses. Precision was evaluated using repeatability and reproducibility testing using coefficients of variation (CVs). Differences in mean VL measurements were assessed with one‐way analysis of variance (ANOVA). Results The platforms showed comparable log 10 VL and acceptable precision across all targets. Deming regression identified constant bias in comparisons and proportional bias in one HCV comparison. Passing–Bablok regression and Lin's concordance correlation coefficient further showed that agreement differed. ANOVA showed no significant differences for HBV and HCV, while HIV showed a significant difference in VL values. Conclusion The platforms demonstrated acceptable precision for quantitative HIV, HBV and HCV VL testing. Roche cobas 5800 system showed low CVs in several repeatability comparisons, while within‐laboratory reproducibility showed variability for HBV and HIV. Agreement analyses identified constant bias, proportional bias and variability in platform comparisons.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the inter-platform agreement, bias and precision of three automated molecular platforms for viral load (VL) quantification of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV). elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV)、乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 的病毒载量 (VL) 定量对于临床监测、治疗 反应评估和捐赠后解释至关重要。该研究旨在评估用于 HBV、HIV 和 HCV VL 检测的自动化分子平台的平台间一致性、偏差和精度。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用来自献血者的 280 个血浆样本进行了比较研究。该研究评估了 Roche cobas 5800 系统、Abbott Alinity m 系统以及 Hologic Panther 系统上相关 Aptima 定量分析在定量 VL 范围内的性能。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 Deming 回归、Passing-Bablok 回归、Lin 一致性相关系数和 Bland-Altman 分析来评估平台之间的一致性。使用具有变异系数 (CV) 的重复性和再现性测试来评估精度。通过单向方差分析 (ANOVA) 评估平均 VL 测量值的差异。
elements_zh.main_results: 该平台在所有目标上均显示出可比的 log 10 VL 和可接受的精度。方差分析显示 HBV 和 HCV 没有显着差异,而 HIV 的 VL 值有显着差异。一致性分析确定了平台比较中的恒定偏差、比例偏差和变异性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该平台在定量 HIV、HBV 和 HCV VL 检测方面表现出可接受的精度。该研究对 HBV、HIV 和 HCV 三个平台的 VL 测量值进行了直接比较,强调了在临床环境中评估平台间一致性的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为临床和公共卫生环境中选择合适的 HBV、HIV 和 HCV VL 检测平台提供参考。他们支持使用这些平台进行准确监控和 治疗 响应评估。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究使用了一组来自献血者的血浆样本,这可能会限制普遍性。证据是温和的,因为它基于一项具有可接受的精度和所有目标的一致性的比较研究。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用来自献血者的 280 个血浆样本进行了比较研究。该研究评估了 Roche cobas 5800 系统、Abbott Alinity m 系统以及 Hologic Panther 系统上相关 Aptima 定量分析在定量 VL 范围内的性能。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该平台在定量 HIV、HBV 和 HCV VL 检测方面表现出可接受的精度。该研究对 HBV、HIV 和 HCV 三个平台的 VL 测量值进行了直接比较,强调了在临床环境中评估平台间一致性的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为临床和公共卫生环境中选择合适的 HBV、HIV 和 HCV VL 检测平台提供参考。他们支持使用这些平台进行准确监控和 治疗 响应评估。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究使用了一组来自献血者的血浆样本,这可能会限制普遍性。证据是温和的,因为它基于一项具有可接受的精度和所有目标的一致性的比较研究。

papers.title: The present and future of HIV and viral hepatitis co-infection.
papers.abstract: HIV and hepatitis virus co-infection remains a major global health challenge, driven by shared transmission routes, populations with overlapping modes of acquisition, and potentially compounded disease progression. Co-infections of HIV and hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) remain prevalent, particularly among people who live in endemic areas, key populations, people who inject drugs, men who have sex with men, and migrants from endemic regions. Antiretroviral therapy is shifting towards regimens without HBV activity, increasing the risk for HBV infection or reactivation in some individuals. Although direct-acting antivirals have reduced active HCV infection considerably in many high-income settings, residual disease burden, reinfections, and inequitable access to treatment persist. Hepatitis delta virus continues to represent a severe but underdiagnosed co-infection among individuals with HIV-HBV co-infection, with insufficient global surveillance data. Acute hepatitis A and E increasingly affect people with HIV, presenting both as outbreak-related and sporadic cases, particularly in the context of suboptimal vaccination coverage. Contemporary management emphasises systematic screening, vaccination, integrated antiviral strategies, and public health interventions to reduce liver-related morbidity and mortality in people with HIV.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the challenges and implications of hepatitis B virus (HBV) co-infection with HIV. It highlights the global health burden of HBV, particularly in populations with overlapping transmission routes. The evidence suggests that antiretroviral therapy is increasingly avoiding HBV activity, which may increase the risk of HBV infection or reactivation. Despite progress in treating hepatitis C virus (HCV) with direct-acting antivirals, challenges such as residual disease burden, reinfections, and treatment access remain. Additionally, hepatitis delta virus (HDV) is noted as a severe but underdiagnosed co-infection in individuals with HIV-HBV co-infection, with limited global surveillance data. The review emphasizes the need for systematic screening, vaccination, and integrated antiviral strategies to reduce liver-related morbidity and mortality in people living with HIV.

papers.abstract_zh: HIV与肝炎病毒共感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战,其原因包括共同的传播途径、具有重叠获得方式的人群以及可能加剧的疾病进展。HIV与乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)的共感染仍然普遍,尤其是在流行区生活的人群、关键人群、注射毒品者、男男性行为者以及来自流行区的移民中。抗逆转录病毒治疗正朝着不含HBV活性的方案转变,这使得某些个体感染或重新激活HBV的风险增加。尽管直接作用抗病毒药物(DAAs)在许多高收入地区显著降低了HCV的活动性感染,但残留的疾病负担、再感染以及对治疗的不平等获取仍然存在。肝炎delta病毒(HDV)继续作为HIV-HBV共感染个体中一种严重但未被充分诊断的共感染存在,且全球关于其诊断的数据仍不充分。急性甲型肝炎和戊型肝炎越来越多地影响HIV感染者,表现为与HIV相关的病例和散发病例,特别是在血清学监测覆盖率不足的背景下。当代管理强调系统性筛查、血清学监测、整合治疗策略以及公共卫生干预措施,以减少HIV感染者与肝炎相关的发病率和死亡率。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管直接作用抗病毒药物(DAAs)在许多高收入地区显著降低了HCV的活动性感染,但残留的疾病负担、再感染以及对治疗的不平等获取仍然存在。

papers.title: Anti‐Viral Treatment Eligibility and Treatment Uptake Among People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Australia: The REACH ‐B Study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Treatment indication for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) varies across clinical guidelines. This study evaluated treatment eligibility and uptake in a large Australian cohort of people with CHB. The REACH‐B study recruited people with CHB managed through a national network of healthcare services. Participants were categorised into three groups: (1) receiving antiviral therapy; (2) untreated despite eligibility; (3) untreated and ineligible. Treatment eligibility was determined using Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) criteria, and by international clinical guidelines. Among 3648 participants (56% male; median age 48 years; 49% born in North‐East or South‐East Asia; 27% First Nations Australians), 14% were HBeAg positive and 7% had cirrhosis. Overall, 47% ( n = 1666) were on antiviral therapy, 45% ( n = 1573) were untreated and ineligible and 7% ( n = 251) were untreated despite eligibility based on Australian PBS criteria. In adjusted analysis, the likelihood of remaining untreated despite eligibility was higher among women (aOR 1.59, 95% CI 1.34, 1.88) and younger participants (age 41–60 vs. > 60 years: aOR 1.51, 95% CI 1.01–2.28; ≤ 40 vs. > 60 years: aOR 2.65, 95% CI 1.60, 4.40). The proportion untreated despite eligibility increased to 13% when applying 2024 World Health Organisation guidelines and ranged 2%–44% based on other guidelines, highlighting the variability across the guidelines. In conclusion, among REACH‐B participants, most eligible individuals receive treatment. Lower treatment uptake among women and younger people despite eligibility partly reflects lower threshold for elevated ALT in women, and clinician determination of non‐CHB related ALT elevation. As treatment guidelines evolve and eligibility criteria broaden, monitoring treatment patterns is important.

papers.title: Sustained HBsAg Loss and Marked Reversal of Liver Cirrhosis in a Patient with Antiviral-Resistant Chronic Hepatitis B: A Case Report with 13-Year Follow-up
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Achieving sustained hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss and reversing established cirrhosis is considered extremely challenging, especially in patients with prior antiviral resistance. We report a case of marked reversal of liver cirrhosis and sustained HBsAg loss in a patient with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who previously failed standard antiviral therapy. Case Presentation A 60-year-old male patient was diagnosed with CHB in 2006 and developed cirrhosis after 6 years of standard antiviral therapy at a top-tier hospital. In February 2012, his liver stiffness (FibroScan) was 19.9 kPa, with HBV DNA at 1.47×10^7 IU/ml. He subsequently received combined Chinese-Western medicine ("Neo-Chinese Medicine") treatment. After 7 years and 2 months of treatment, his liver function normalized, HBV DNA became undetectable, and FibroScan decreased to 5.1 kPa. Notably, the patient achieved HBsAg loss and Pre-S1 antigen negativity. All medications were discontinued in April 2019. By November 2020, despite the patient developing hyperlipidemia and steatohepatitis due to lifestyle factors, imaging and elastography confirmed a marked reversal of cirrhosis (FibroScan: 6.2 kPa, normal portal vein diameter of 12 mm) without disease progression. Long-term follow-up up to 2025 consistently showed sustained HBsAg negativity (< 0.05 IU/ml) and undetectable highly sensitive HBV DNA. Conclusion This case demonstrates that Neo-Chinese Medicine can achieve marked reversal of cirrhosis and sustained functional cure in patients with antiviral-resistant CHB. The durability of these outcomes after treatment discontinuation suggests a fundamental restoration of the hepatic microenvironment and the depletion of the viral reservoir.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 实现乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 持续消失并逆转已形成的肝硬化被认为​​极具挑战性,特别是对于既往具有 抗病毒药物 耐药性的患者。该研究旨在报告一名 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者的肝硬化显着逆转和持续 HBsAg 消失的病例,该患者之前标准 抗病毒药物 治疗失败。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一名60岁男性患者于2006年被诊断出慢性乙型肝炎,在一家三甲医院接受标准抗病毒药物治疗6年后发展为肝硬化。该病例随访时间为2012年2月至2020年11月,治疗涉及中西医结合(“新中医”)。
elements_zh.methods: 患者接受中西医结合(“新中医”)治疗治疗。在随访期间监测肝功能、HBV DNA 和肝硬度 (FibroScan)。
elements_zh.main_results: 经过7年零2个月的治疗治疗,患者的肝功能恢复正常,HBV DNA检测不到,FibroScan降至5.1 kPa。值得注意的是,患者的 HBsAg 消失且 Pre-S1 抗原呈阴性。截至 2025 年的长期随访一致显示 HBsAg 持续阴性(< 0.05 IU/ml)和无法检测到的高度敏感的 HBV DNA。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例表明,新中医药可以对抗病毒药物耐药的慢乙肝患者实现显着逆转肝硬化和持续功能性治愈治疗。治疗 停药后这些结果的持久性表明肝脏微环境的根本恢复和病毒 储存宿主 的消耗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,新中医药可能为治疗 抗病毒药物 耐药的 CHB 提供一种有前途的方法,有可能导致持续的 功能性治愈 和逆转肝硬化。这可能对 慢性乙型肝炎 及相关并发症的治疗产生重大影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到 病例报告 设计的限制,无法推广到其他患者。由于缺乏对照组以及缺乏详细的 治疗 方案和结果,因此很难评估新中医疗法的具体贡献。由于该研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 实现乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 持续消失并逆转已形成的肝硬化被认为​​极具挑战性,特别是对于既往具有 抗病毒药物 耐药性的患者。该研究旨在报告一名 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者的肝硬化显着逆转和持续 HBsAg 消失的病例,该患者之前标准 抗病毒药物 治疗失败。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一名60岁男性患者于2006年被诊断出慢性乙型肝炎,在一家三甲医院接受标准抗病毒药物治疗6年后发展为肝硬化。该病例随访时间为2012年2月至2020年11月,治疗涉及中西医结合(“新中医”)。
analysis_zh.methods: 患者接受中西医结合(“新中医”)治疗治疗。在随访期间监测肝功能、HBV DNA 和肝硬度 (FibroScan)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 经过7年零2个月的治疗治疗,患者的肝功能恢复正常,HBV DNA检测不到,FibroScan降至5.1 kPa。值得注意的是,患者的 HBsAg 消失且 Pre-S1 抗原呈阴性。截至 2025 年的长期随访一致显示 HBsAg 持续阴性(< 0.05 IU/ml)和无法检测到的高度敏感的 HBV DNA。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例表明,新中医药可以对抗病毒药物耐药的慢乙肝患者实现显着逆转肝硬化和持续功能性治愈治疗。治疗 停药后这些结果的持久性表明肝脏微环境的根本恢复和病毒 储存宿主 的消耗。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,新中医药可能为治疗 抗病毒药物 耐药的 CHB 提供一种有前途的方法,有可能导致持续的 功能性治愈 和逆转肝硬化。这可能对 慢性乙型肝炎 及相关并发症的治疗产生重大影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到 病例报告 设计的限制,无法推广到其他患者。由于缺乏对照组以及缺乏详细的 治疗 方案和结果,因此很难评估新中医疗法的具体贡献。由于该研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Prospective Evaluation of Hepatitis B Virus Reactivation in Cancer Patients Receiving Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
papers.abstract: Data on hepatitis B virus reactivation (HBVr) during tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy remain limited. We prospectively enrolled patients with chronic or resolved HBV receiving TKIs for lung cancer or chronic myeloid leukemia at one Taiwanese center (January 2023-March 2025). HBV DNA and liver enzymes were monitored 12-weekly and HBsAg 24-weekly. HBVr was defined by AASLD criteria, with APASL and EASL definitions applied secondarily. Among 79 patients (20 HBsAg-positive, 59 resolved HBV), none received antiviral prophylaxis. Median follow-up was 42 weeks (IQR, 19-65). HBVr occurred in 7 (8.9%; 95% CI, 4.4%-17.2%): 5 HBsAg-positive (25.0%; 95% CI, 11.2%-46.9%), and 2 with resolved HBV (3.4%; 95% CI, 0.9%-11.5%). APASL and EASL definitions yielded 30.0% and 35.0% in HBsAg-positive patients, with no additional events in resolved HBV. No HBVr-associated hepatitis flare meeting the study definition was observed, although transient flares between assessments could not be excluded and deterioration in one fatal case was attributed clinically to sepsis. Median HBVr detection time was 19 weeks (IQR, 14-30). Week-48 Kaplan-Meier HBVr incidence was 37.5% (95% CI, 17.0%-69.5%) in HBsAg-positive and 5.6% (95% CI, 1.4%-21.2%) in resolved HBV (log-rank p < 0.001); Aalen-Johansen estimates were 28.3% (95% CI, 9.5%-50.9%) and 4.3% (95% CI, 0.8%-13.2%), respectively. In exploratory Firth-corrected regression, HBsAg positivity was associated with HBVr (HR, 6.95; 95% CI, 1.60-40.19), while osimertinib exposure was not. HBVr was common among HBsAg-positive patients and less common but not negligible among those with resolved HBV receiving TKIs.

We prospectively enrolled patients with chronic or resolved HBV receiving TKIs for lung cancer or chronic myeloid leukemia at one Taiwanese center (January 2023-March 2025). HBV DNA and liver enzymes were monitored 12-weekly and HBsAg 24-weekly. HBVr was defined by AASLD criteria, with APASL and EASL definitions applied secondarily. Among 79 patients (20 HBsAg-positive, 59 resolved HBV), none received antiviral prophylaxis. Median follow-up was 42 weeks (IQR, 19-65). HBVr occurred in 7 (8.9%; 95% CI, 4.4%-17.2%): 5 HBsAg-positive (25.0%; 95% CI, 11.2%-46.9%), and 2 with resolved HBV (3.4%; 95% CI, 0.9%-11.5%). APASL and EASL definitions yielded 30.0% and 35.0% in HBsAg-positive patients, with no additional events in resolved HBV. No HBVr-associated hepatitis flare meeting the study definition was observed, although transient flares between assessments could not be excluded and deterioration in one fatal case was attributed clinically to sepsis. Median HBVr detection time was 19 weeks (IQR, 14-30). Week-48 Kaplan-Meier HBVr incidence was 37.5% (95% CI, 17.0%-69.5%) in HBsAg-positive and 5.6% (95% CI, 1.4%-21.2%) in resolved HBV (log-rank p < 0.001); Aalen-Johansen estimates were 28.3% (95% CI, 9.5%-50.9%) and 4.3% (95% CI, 0.8%-13.2%), respectively. In exploratory Firth-corrected regression, HBsAg positivity was associated with HBVr (HR, 6.95; 95% CI, 1.60-40.19), while osimertinib exposure was not. HBVr was common among HBsAg-positive patients and less common but not negligible among those with resolved HBV receiving TKIs.

analysis.summary_en: This study prospectively evaluated hepatitis B virus reactivation (HBVr) in cancer patients receiving tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) at a single Taiwanese center. The research aimed to address the limited data on HBVr during TKI therapy. HBV DNA and liver enzymes were monitored 12-weekly, while HBsAg was checked 24-weekly. Among 79 patients (20 HBsAg-positive, 59 resolved HBV), none received antiviral prophylaxis. HBVr occurred in 7 patients (8.9%; 95% CI, 4.4%-17.2%), with 5 HBsAg-positive patients (25.0%; 95% CI, 11.2%-46.9%) and 2 resolved HBV patients (3.4%; 95% CI, 0.9%-11.5%). elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 关于酪氨酸激酶抑制剂 (TKI) 治疗期间 乙型肝炎病毒 再激活 (HBVr) 的数据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们前瞻性地招募了在台湾的一个中心(2023 年 1 月至 2025 年 3 月)接受 TKI 治疗肺癌或慢性粒细胞白血病的慢性或已治愈的 HBV 患者。

papers.title: Hepatitis B seroprevalence among children aged 0.6-14 years in Jiangsu, China, in 2023-2025.
papers.abstract: China has implemented universal hepatitis B vaccination in all neonates since 2002 and has enhanced prophylaxis against mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) by providing charge-free hepatitis B immunoglobulin in infants of HBV-infected mothers since 2011 and by recommending routine antiviral prophylaxis in HBV-infected mothers with high viral loads since 2020. We aimed to survey the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) in children born from 2010 to 2024 in Jiangsu Province, based on convenience sampling in children who visited hospitals. We tested hepatitis B markers in 20,317 children aged 7.9 ± 4.1 years, with 11477 boys and 8840 girls, from 8 cities across Jiangsu during February 2023 to December 2025. Of them, 14 (0.069%, 95% CI: 0.038-0.116) were HBsAg positive. The positive rates of HBsAg in 0.5-<3, 3-<6, 6-<9, 9-<12, and 12-<15 years groups were 0% (0/2520), 0% (0/3858), 0.024% (1/4243), 0.136% (6/4401), and 0.132% (7/5295), respectively (P = .01489). The overall positive rate of antibody against HBsAg was 68.11% (12046/17686), with a decreasing trend over the ages (from 96.17% in 0.5-<3 year children to 48.41% in 12-<15 year children). In HBsAg-negative children, the positive rate of antibody against hepatitis B core antigen was 7.68% (1383/18007), increasing from 4.23% in 0.5-<3 year children to 7.84% in 12-<15 year children (Z = 5.0398, P < .0001). The present study showed that HBsAg prevalence among children in Jiangsu has substantially declined since the implementation of enhanced prevention of HBV perinatal infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过对就诊儿童进行便利抽样,对江苏省2010年至2024年出生的儿童乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)血清流行率进行调查。中国自 2002 年起在所有新生儿中实施全民乙型肝炎 传播,并自 2011 年起为 HBV 感染母亲的婴儿提供免费乙型肝炎免疫球蛋白,并自 2011 年起推荐对高病毒载量的 HBV 感染母亲进行常规 抗病毒药物 预防,从而加强对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 母婴 传播 的预防。2020.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为江苏乙型肝炎预防策略的成功提供了证据,可为其他地区采取类似干预措施的公共卫生政策和 监测 乙型肝炎防治工作提供参考。

papers.title: Effectiveness of combined intramuscular and intravenous administration of hepatitis B immunoglobulin to newborns in preventing mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective While achieving a good success rate of approximately 95% in preventing mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV), 10-20% of infants born to HBeAg-positive or high-viral-load mothers still become infected. Study Design To strengthen the prevention of HBV MTCT at birth, intravenous injection was added to the conventional regimen of intramuscular hepatitis B immune globulin (HBIG) administration immediately after delivery, thereby achieving a more rapid rise in blood antibody levels. Vaccination was initiated once antibody titers had declined to a certain level. Results The study method maintained higher levels than existing methods for approximately 4 months post-delivery. No infection was detected at one year of age in the seven HBeAg-positive cases(including two involving in utero infection) and the five cases with high viral loads (≥5.3 log IU/mL). Conclusions Designed to protect newborns from HBV infection by enhancing their defenses against infection immediately after birth, this offers a new option.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a combined intramuscular and intravenous administration of hepatitis B immunoglobulin (HBIG) in preventing mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of hepatitis B virus (HBV), as current methods still result in 10-20% of infants born to HBeAg-positive or high-viral-load mothers becoming infected.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was designed to strengthen the prevention of HBV MTCT at birth by adding intravenous injection to the conventional regimen of intramuscular HBIG administration immediately after delivery. It included infants born to HBeAg-positive or high-viral-load mothers.
analysis.methods: The study method involved administering both intramuscular and intravenous HBIG to newborns immediately after delivery, with vaccination initiated once antibody titers had declined to a certain level.
analysis.main_results: The study method maintained higher levels than existing methods for approximately 4 months post-delivery. No infection was detected at one year of age in the seven HBeAg-positive cases (including two involving in utero infection) and the five cases with high viral loads (≥5.3 log IU/mL).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating that the combined administration of intramuscular and intravenous HBIG offers a new option for protecting newborns from HBV infection by enhancing their defenses immediately after birth.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that this combined method could improve the prevention of HBV MTCT, particularly in high-risk cases, and may inform future strategies for more effective postnatal interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the results are based on a small number of cases, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the effectiveness of a combined intramuscular and intravenous administration of hepatitis B immunoglobulin (HBIG) in preventing mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of hepatitis B virus (HBV) in newborns. The research highlights that while current methods achieve a 95% success rate, 10-20% of infants born to HBeAg-positive or high-viral-load mothers still become infected. The study design introduces intravenous HBIG to enhance antibody levels post-delivery, with vaccination initiated once titers decline. Results show that the combined method maintained higher antibody levels for about 4 months and achieved no infections at one year in seven HBeAg-positive and five high-viral-load cases. The authors interpret these findings as offering a new preventive option for HBV MTCT. The study's implications suggest potential improvements in postnatal interventions for high-risk infants, though the evidence is based on abstract-only data and limited sample size, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

papers.title: Enabling Person‐Centred Chronic Hepatitis B Care Among Migrant Men Who Have Sex With Men and Female Sex Workers
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim(s) To explore experiences of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) care among migrant MSM and female sex workers attending a specialist sexual health clinic and identify perceived enablers of person‐centred care. Design Qualitative interview study. Methods Semi‐structured interviews with 14 overseas‐born men who have sex with men (MSM, n = 7) and cisgender and transgender female sex workers ( n = 7) attending a publicly funded sexual health clinic in Sydney, Australia. Data were analysed using thematic analysis, with interpretation informed by the Person‐Centred Practice Framework. Results Sexual health services were experienced as safe spaces where CHB was often identified during routine screening, enabling participants to initiate or re‐engage with care. Care engagement was shaped by macro‐context factors including visa status, Medicare access, language needs, culturally embedded understandings of CHB and referral pathways. Trusting relationships with sexual health practitioners supported discussion of sex, migration and CHB, although some interactions were experienced as directive and overly risk‐focused, undermining relational safety. Participants described CHB as having low salience in everyday life but becoming more prominent during intimate moments such as disclosure, partner reassurance and sex work decisions. For some participants, PrEP or HIV therapy offered dual HIV–CHB benefits, making treatment feel more worthwhile and easier to take up. Participants navigated system barriers through peer networks, information‐seeking, and services aligned with their needs. Conclusion Person‐centred CHB care for migrant MSM and female sex workers requires more than clinical monitoring. Care should be responsive to the intersecting effects of migration, sexuality, sex work, intimacy and access to health services, while creating culturally and relationally safe environments that support trust, disclosure and sustained engagement. Implications This study calls for embedding CHB care within routine sexual health and HIV care, strengthening language support, improving referral coordination, and supporting clinicians to use reflexive, non‐directive communication to avoid moralising or ‘risk‐only’ framings. Patient or Public Contribution None.

papers.title: Liver concentrations of JNJ-73763989 siRNA triggers in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB): The INSIGHT study panel 3 results
papers.abstract: Background JNJ-73763989 is a 2:1 combination of 2 N-acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc)–conjugated short interfering RNAs (siRNA) targeting the S (daplusiran) and X (tomligisiran) regions of the hepatitis B virus genome. In phase 2b studies, 48 weeks of JNJ-73763989-based combination treatments led to dose-dependent reductions in viral markers, including hepatitis B surface antigen. The objective of the INSIGHT study Panel 3 was to quantify intrahepatic concentrations of the siRNAs in human livers during and after treatment. Methods In the open-label, single-arm, single-center study, participants with chronic hepatitis B received 48 weeks of treatment with JNJ-73763989 200 mg every 4 weeks and nucleos(t)ide analog, with optional pegylated interferon α2a 180 μg weekly added after Treatment Week (TW) 40. Core liver biopsies were collected at TW12, TW40, and at Follow-up Week (FUW) 24. Results Liver biopsies were available from all 4 participants at TW12 and from 3 at TW40 and FUW24. Between TW12 and TW40, liver concentrations of daplusiran and tomligisiran increased 1.5- to 2.6-fold, consistent with intrahepatic accumulation. Twenty-eight weeks after the last injection of JNJ-73763989, the triggers were still measurable in 2 of 3 participants with 4.5- to 15-fold reduced concentrations from peak levels; the estimated liver half-life ranged from approximately 2.9 to 16.1 weeks. Conclusions In this first study to assess liver concentrations of GalNAc-siRNA in humans with sequential biopsies, long persistence of JNJ-73763989 triggers in human livers may partially explain the prolonged suppressive effect on viral parameters observed in phase 2 studies.
