analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to quantify intrahepatic concentrations of siRNAs in patients with chronic hepatitis B during and after treatment with JNJ-73763989, a 2:1 combination of GalNAc-conjugated siRNAs targeting the S and X regions of the hepatitis B virus genome.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This open-label, single-arm, single-center study involved participants with chronic hepatitis B who received 48 weeks of treatment with JNJ-73763989 200 mg every 4 weeks combined with nucleos(t)ide analog, and optional pegylated interferon α2a 180 μg weekly after Treatment Week 40.
analysis.methods: Liver biopsies were collected at specific time points during and after treatment to measure the concentrations of the siRNA triggers, with core biopsies obtained at Treatment Week 12, 40, and Follow-up Week 24.
analysis.main_results: Liver biopsies were available from all 4 participants at Treatment Week 12 and from 3 at Treatment Week 40 and Follow-up Week 24. Between Treatment Week 12 and 40, liver concentrations of daplusiran and tomligisiran increased 1.5- to 2.6-fold, consistent with intrahepatic accumulation. Twenty-eight weeks after the last injection, the triggers were still measurable in 2 of 3 participants with 4.5- to 15-fold reduced concentrations from peak levels.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the prolonged suppressive effect on viral parameters observed in phase 2 studies may be partially explained by the long persistence of JNJ-73763989 siRNA triggers in human livers.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the pharmacokinetics of GalNAc-siRNA therapies in the liver, which could inform the development of more effective treatment strategies for chronic hepatitis B.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited by the small sample size and the fact that liver biopsies were not available for all participants at all time points, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study quantified intrahepatic concentrations of JNJ-73763989 siRNA triggers in patients with chronic hepatitis B during and after treatment. The open-label, single-arm, single-center trial involved 4 participants who received 48 weeks of treatment with JNJ-73763989 combined with nucleos(t)ide analogs. Liver biopsies were collected at specific time points to measure siRNA levels, revealing dose-dependent accumulation and prolonged persistence of the triggers in the liver. The findings suggest that the long-term suppression of viral markers observed in phase 2 studies may be due to the extended presence of the siRNA in liver tissue. The study's small sample size and incomplete biopsy data limit the strength of the evidence, which is considered moderate.

papers.title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者的 JNJ-73763989 siRNA 触发剂肝脏浓度:INSIGHT 研究小组 3 结果
papers.source_body_en: Background JNJ-73763989 is a 2:1 combination of 2 N-acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc)–conjugated short interfering RNAs (siRNA) targeting the S (daplusiran) and X (tomligisiran) regions of the hepatitis B virus genome. In phase 2b studies, 48 weeks of JNJ-73763989-based combination treatments led to dose-dependent reductions in viral markers, including hepatitis B surface antigen. The objective of the INSIGHT study Panel 3 was to quantify intrahepatic concentrations of the siRNAs in human livers during and after treatment. Methods In the open-label, single-arm, single-center study, participants with chronic hepatitis B received 48 weeks of treatment with JNJ-73763989 200 mg every 4 weeks and nucleos(t)ide analog, with optional pegylated interferon α2a 180 μg weekly added after Treatment Week (TW) 40. Core liver biopsies were collected at TW12, TW40, and at Follow-up Week (FUW) 24. Results Liver biopsies were available from all 4 participants at TW12 and from 3 at TW40 and FUW24. Between TW12 and TW40, liver concentrations of daplusiran and tomligisiran increased 1.5- to 2.6-fold, consistent with intrahepatic accumulation. Twenty-eight weeks after the last injection of JNJ-73763989, the triggers were still measurable in 2 of 3 participants with 4.5- to 15-fold reduced concentrations from peak levels; the estimated liver half-life ranged from approximately 2.9 to 16.1 weeks. Conclusions In this first study to assess liver concentrations of GalNAc-siRNA in humans with sequential biopsies, long persistence of JNJ-73763989 triggers in human livers may partially explain the prolonged suppressive effect on viral parameters observed in phase 2 studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 JNJ-73763989 是一种靶向 乙型肝炎病毒 基因组 的 S(daplusiran)和 X(tomligisiran)区域的 2:1 组合的 N-乙酰半乳糖胺(GalNAc)偶联小干扰 RNA(siRNA)。在 II 期 2b 研究中,基于 JNJ-73763989 的组合 治疗 持续 48 周可导致病毒标志物(包括乙型肝炎病毒表面抗原)剂量依赖性下降。INSIGHT 研究第三部分的目标是量化在 治疗 治疗期间和治疗后,人类肝脏中 siRNA 的肝内浓度。方法 在一项开放标签、单臂、单中心研究中,患有 慢性乙型肝炎 的受试者接受了 48 周的 治疗 治疗,每 4 周给予 JNJ-73763989 200 mg,并联合核苷(酸)类似物治疗,可选择在 治疗 第 40 周后每周添加聚乙二醇化干扰素 α2a 180 μg。核心肝活检分别在第 12 周(TW12)、第 40 周(TW40)和随访第 24 周(FUW24)进行。结果 所有 4 名受试者在 TW12 均提供了肝活检样本,3 名受试者在 TW40 和 FUW24 提供了样本。在 TW12 和 TW40 之间,daplusiran 和 tomligisiran 的肝内浓度增加了 1.5 至 2.6 倍,与肝内蓄积一致。在最后一次 JNJ-73763989 注射后 28 周,仍有 2 名受试者检测到可测量的触发物,其浓度较峰值水平降低了 4.5 至 15 倍,估计肝内半衰期范围为约 2.9 至 16.1 周。结论 这是首个在人类中通过连续活检评估 GalNAc-siRNA 肝内浓度的研究。JNJ-73763989 在人类肝脏中的长期存在可能部分解释了 II 期研究中观察到的病毒参数持续抑制效应。

papers.title: Factors influencing breastfeeding intention among hepatitis B virus-infected mothers: An ABC-X cross-sectional analysis
papers.abstract: Despite international guideline recommendations supporting breastfeeding among HBV-infected mothers, breastfeeding rates remain suboptimal. This study investigated factors influencing breastfeeding intention among HBV-infected mothers using the ABC-X theoretical framework. A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January to December 2025 among 119 HBV-infected pregnant women. Structured questionnaires assessed demographic characteristics, disease-related factors, social support, self-efficacy, stigma, breastfeeding attitudes, and breastfeeding intention. Descriptive statistics, t-tests, chi-square tests, and multivariate logistic regression were performed. Among participants, 45.3% (n = 54) intended to breastfeed. Univariate analysis showed significant differences in self-efficacy (p = 0.003) and breastfeeding attitude scores (p = 0.046) between mothers with and without breastfeeding intention. After adjustment for potential confounders, self-efficacy was the only independent predictor of breastfeeding intention (OR = 3.71, 95% CI: 1.35–10.19, p = 0.011). The prediction model showed good discrimination, with an area under the ROC curve of 0.782. Maternal self-efficacy was the strongest predictor of breastfeeding intention among HBV-infected mothers. Interventions enhancing self-efficacy and clearly communicating breastfeeding safety with immunoprophylaxis may improve breastfeeding support in this population.

papers.title: Occult Hepatitis B Virus Infection Among HBsAg-Negative Maintenance Haemodialysis Patients in Malaysia: Association with Anti-HBs Serostatus
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Occult Hepatitis B infection (OBI)—defined as the presence of replication-competent HBV DNA in HBsAg-negative individuals—poses a severe transmission and reactivation risk in haemodialysis units. This study aims to investigate the prevalence and clinical characteristics of detectable HBV DNA among HBsAg-negative maintenance haemodialysis patients, particularly those with anti-HBc positivity. Methods A retrospective observational study was conducted involving 2,146 patients who attended the dialysis unit at Universiti Malaya Medical Centre (UMMC) from 1 January 2019 to 30 June 2024. Patients established on maintenance haemodialysis were included, while those with HBsAg positivity or missing data were excluded. Patient demographics, clinical variables, and biochemical information were extracted from the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Data collection was conducted using REDCap version 14.3.13, and statistical analysis was performed using SPSS version 29.0 and Python version 3.10.16. A Firth penalised multivariable binary logistic regression model was constructed utilising OBI status as the dependent variable to identify independent clinical predictors, addressing potential small-sample bias inherent in standard logistic regression. Results Among 2,146 screened patients, 1,635 patients were included. Anti-HBc IgG positivity was identified in 23.5% (N = 384) of the cohort. HBV DNA testing was not performed in 146 patients under the testing practices prevailing during the study period. Within the tested core-positive subgroup (N = 238), overall OBI prevalence was 9.2% (N = 22). In patients with positive HBV DNA, 54.6% were concurrently Anti-HBs IgG positive (≥ 10 IU/L), and 18.2% possessed an Anti-HBs IgG level ≥ 100 IU/L. The multivariable Firth penalised logistic regression model revealed that while an Anti-HBs titre ≥ 10 IU/L was a significant negative predictor of OBI (OR 0.18, 95% CI 0.07–0.50, p = 0.001), it failed to exclude active viraemia entirely. Conclusion Our study identified an overall OBI prevalence of 9.2% in a tested Malaysian ESKD cohort. Firth penalised logistic regression model utilising OBI status as the dependent variable confirmed that relying solely on Anti-HBs IgG to infer viral clearance is inadequate in this immunocompromised population, especially given that over half (54.6%) of OBI patients maintained Anti-HBs IgG positivity.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the prevalence and clinical characteristics of occult Hepatitis B Virus infection (OBI) among HBsAg-negative maintenance haemodialysis patients in Malaysia, focusing on those with anti-HBc positivity. A retrospective observational study was conducted at Universiti Malaya Medical Centre involving 2,146 patients from 2019 to 2024. Among the 1,635 included patients, 23.5% had anti-HBc IgG positivity, and within the tested core-positive subgroup (N = 238), OBI prevalence was 9.2% (N = 22). elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 隐匿性 传播 感染 (OBI)——定义为 HBsAg 阴性个体中存在有复制能力的 HBV DNA——在血液透析单位造成严重的 传播 和再激活风险。本研究旨在探讨 HBsAg 阴性维持性血液透析患者,特别是抗 HBc 阳性患者的 患病率 和可检测 HBV DNA 的临床特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性观察研究涉及 2,146 名于 2019 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年 6 月 30 日期间在马来亚大学医学中心(UMMC)透析室就诊的患者。包括接受维持性血液透析的患者,而 HBsAg 阳性或数据缺失的患者被排除在外。
elements_zh.methods: 从电子病历 (EMR) 中提取患者人口统计数据、临床变量和生化信息。使用REDCap版本14.3.13进行数据收集,并使用SPSS版本29.0和Python版本3.10.16进行统计分析。利用 OBI 状态作为因变量构建了 Firth 惩罚多变量二元逻辑回归模型,以识别独立的临床预测因子,解决标准逻辑回归中固有的潜在小样本偏差。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 2,146 名筛查患者中,纳入了 1,635 名患者。23.5% (N = 384) 的 队列研究 检测出抗 HBc IgG 阳性。根据研究期间流行的检测实践,未对 146 名患者进行 HBV DNA 检测。在测试的核心阳性亚组 (N = 238) 中,总体 OBI 患病率 为 9.2% (N = 22)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: The multivariable Firth penalised logistic regression model revealed that while an Anti-HBs titre ≥ 10 IU/L was a significant negative predictor of OBI (OR 0.18, 95% CI 0.07–0.50, p = 0.001), it failed to exclude active viraemia entirely.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告研究设计的具体局限性或证据的强度。

papers.title: Hepatic Steatosis in People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Africa: Prevalence, Correlates, and Clinical Significance.
papers.abstract: To address data gaps around metabolic liver disease in Africa, within the Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET), we evaluated participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection (CHB) for steatotic liver disease (SLD) using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). Using multivariable logistic regression, we identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical associations with SLD (CAP ≥ 248 dB/m), and evaluated whether SLD severity was independently associated with fibrosis. Short-term impacts of SLD on mortality were also assessed with Cox proportional hazards analysis. We also evaluated the diagnostic performance of B-mode ultrasound for SLD, with CAP as reference. Across 6 countries and 1601 participants (age range, 12-80 years; 39.5% female; 4% with diabetes; 11% unhealthy alcohol use; median body mass index, 24.4), 421 (26.3%) had SLD; 219 (13.7%) had severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). Older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status were associated with SLD. After adjusting for age, sex, HIV status, HBV treatment, and country, severe steatosis, but not mild and moderate forms (i.e., 248-279 dB/m), was associated with a 8.4% (95%, 1.9%-14.9%) increased probability of fibrosis. Over limited follow-up (median 2.69 years) and small number of deaths, SLD was not associated with all-cause or liver-related mortality. B-mode ultrasound had low sensitivity for SLD, overall or when severe, but specificity was 95%. In conclusion, SLD was common in people with CHB in Africa and its severe form was associated with liver fibrosis. These data support screening for metabolic comorbidities as part of HBV care and treatment in Africa.
authors: Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET)

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address data gaps on metabolic liver disease in Africa by evaluating participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection for steatotic liver disease using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). The research was conducted across six countries involving 1601 participants, with 421 (26.3%) found to have SLD and 219 (13.7%) with severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). The study identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical factors associated with SLD, including older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status. After adjusting for various factors, severe steatosis was linked to an increased probability of fibrosis. However, SLD was not associated with mortality during limited follow-up. The findings highlight the importance of screening for metabolic comorbidities in HBV care and suggest that severe steatosis may be a marker for fibrosis. The study's limitations include its short follow-up period and small number of deaths, which may affect the strength of conclusions about mortality.

papers.abstract_zh: 为了解决非洲地区代谢性肝病的数据缺口,我们在非洲乙型肝炎合作网络(HEPSANET)中评估了慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者是否患有脂肪性肝病(SLD),使用了瞬时弹性成像结合控制衰减参数(CAP)。通过多变量逻辑回归分析,我们确定了与SLD(CAP ≥ 248 dB/m)相关的社会人口学、人体测量学和临床特征,并评估了SLD严重程度是否独立与纤维化相关。我们还使用Cox比例风险模型评估了SLD对死亡率的短期影响。此外,我们评估了B型超声波在SLD诊断中的表现,以CAP为参考标准。在6个国家的1601名参与者(年龄范围12-80岁;39.5%女性;4%患有糖尿病;11%有不健康饮酒行为;中位数体重指数24.4)中,421名(26.3%)患有SLD;219名(13.7%)患有严重脂肪变(CAP ≥ 280 dB/m)。年龄较大、男性性别、超重和肥胖以及HIV阴性状态与SLD相关。在调整年龄、性别、HIV状态、HBV 治疗和国家后,严重脂肪变(而非轻度和中度形式,即248-279 dB/m)与纤维化概率增加8.4%(95%置信区间1.9%-14.9%)相关。在有限的随访时间(中位数2.69年)和较少的死亡病例下,SLD与全因或肝相关死亡率无显著关联。B型超声波对SLD的敏感性较低,无论是整体还是在严重情况下,但特异性为95%。总之,SLD在非洲CHB患者中较为常见,其严重形式与肝纤维化相关。这些数据支持在非洲HBV管理中纳入代谢性共病的筛查措施以及治疗的监测。

papers.title: Becoming Physically Active and Risks of Mortality and Liver-Related Events in Adults With Chronic Hepatitis B: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Physical activity (PA) confers several health benefits; however, whether increasing PA among physically inactive adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is associated with lower risks of adverse clinical outcomes remains unclear. We used the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database. We included 318,131 adults with CHB who were physically inactive at the initial health screening (Exam 1) and completed a subsequent screening within 4 years (Exam 2). Among them, 58,703 initiated moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA), defined as vigorous activity ≥ 20 min/day on ≥ 3 days/week or moderate activity ≥ 30 min/day on ≥ 5 days/week. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality, and the secondary outcomes were liver-related events (hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC]) and HCC. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Grey competing-risk models were adjusted for demographic, clinical, and behavioural factors. During a median 7.9-year follow-up (IQR, 5.2-9.5), 7609 deaths occurred. MVPA initiation was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), a lower risk of liver-related events (subdistribution HR [subHR], 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and, more modestly, of HCC (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared with those remaining inactive. The association was more pronounced in older adults, women, never smokers, non-drinkers, and untreated participants (all p for interaction ≤ 0.03). Initiating MVPA among physically inactive adults with CHB was associated with lower risks of mortality and liver-related outcomes. These findings provide large-scale epidemiological evidence supporting further evaluation of PA promotion in physically inactive patients with CHB.

We included 318,131 adults with CHB who were physically inactive at the initial health screening (Exam 1) and completed a subsequent screening within 4 years (Exam 2). Among them, 58,703 initiated moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA), defined as vigorous activity ≥ 20 min/day on ≥ 3 days/week or moderate activity ≥ 30 min/day on ≥ 5 days/week. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality, and the secondary outcomes were liver-related events (hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC]) and HCC. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Grey competing-risk models were adjusted for demographic, clinical, and behavioural factors. During a median 7.9-year follow-up (IQR, 5.2-9.5), 7609 deaths occurred. MVPA initiation was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), a lower risk of liver-related events (subdistribution HR [subHR], 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and, more modestly, of HCC (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared with those remaining inactive. The association was more pronounced in older adults, women, never smokers, non-drinkers, and untreated participants (all p for interaction ≤ 0.03). Initiating MVPA among physically inactive adults with CHB was associated with lower risks of mortality and liver-related outcomes. These findings provide large-scale epidemiological evidence supporting further evaluation of PA promotion in physically inactive patients with CHB.

papers.title: Testing for hepatitis C virus and hepatitis B virus/hepatitis D virus: Current scenarios and perspectives in Italy
papers.abstract: Liver disease accounts for approximately 4% of all deaths worldwide, and viral hepatitis affects more than 300 million people. The World Health Organization aims to reduce new hepatitis infections by 90% and deaths by 65% by 2030 through vaccination and screening programs. In Italy, screening for hepatitis C virus (HCV) benefits from dedicated government funding, whereas testing for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis D virus (HDV) is supported by recommendations from scientific societies but does not benefit from dedicated national public health programmes. This expert-opinion review summarises the experience of tertiary-level Italian centres actively engaged in hospital-based testing for HCV, HBV, and HDV and identifies practical pathways to improve testing and linkage to care. This article presents proposals to improve the effectiveness of viral hepatitis management in Italy by: (1) Strengthening coordination between hospital units and integrating information systems between general practitioners and hospitals; (2) Implementing a centralised reporting system and a structured referral network to ensure that patients with positive test results receive appropriate therapies in a timely manner; (3) Providing the resources needed to increase testing in public addiction treatment services (Servizi per le Dipendenze) and prisons; (4) Promoting screening in high-risk populations, including vulnerable and older populations; and (5) Implementing a national awareness campaign on viral hepatitis. These measures could help Italy make concrete progress towards eliminating HCV infection and controlling HBV/HDV infection within the next decade.

papers.title: Renal Safety and Antiviral Effectiveness of Tenofovir Alafenamide Versus Entecavir in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis B and Chronic Kidney Disease: A Real-World Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Real-world data on tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), especially in patients with advanced renal impairment, are scarce. We evaluated its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness versus entecavir (ETV) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and pre-existing chronic kidney disease (CKD). In this retrospective single-centre study, CHB patients with pre-existing CKD treated with TAF or ETV were included. The primary outcome was change in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) over 48 weeks. Secondary outcomes included virological, biochemical and metabolic responses. Exploratory subgroup analyses were performed by CKD stage and dialysis status. Among 54 patients (35 TAF, 19 ETV), renal function remained stable in both groups. eGFR change from baseline to week 48 was not significantly different between the TAF and ETV groups (1.56 ± 8.14 vs. -0.53 ± 9.78 mL/min/1.73 m2; Δchange, 2.09; 95% CI, -0.35 to 7.68; p = 0.46). Both groups achieved sustained viral suppression, with no significant difference in undetectable HBV DNA in week-48. HBsAg reduction was greater with TAF than with ETV (-0.36 ± 0.42 vs. 0.02 ± 0.34 log10 IU/mL; p = 0.01). Exploratory analyses in patients with eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, TAF showed effective viral suppression and renal safety regardless of dialysis status. Metabolic parameters remained stable, without complex dose adjustments. TAF was safe and effective in CHB patients with CKD, including those with advanced renal impairment. Its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness did not differ significantly from those of ETV, with the practical advantage of fixed dosing without complex adjustment.

The results showed that renal function remained stable in both groups, with no significant difference in eGFR change between TAF and ETV. Exploratory subgroup analyses indicated that TAF was effective and safe in patients with advanced renal impairment. The evidence is limited by the study's retrospective design and small sample size, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

papers.title_zh: tenofovir alafenamide与entecavir在慢性乙型肝炎和慢性肾脏病患者中的肾脏安全性及抗病毒药物有效性:一项真实世界队列研究研究。
papers.source_body_en: Real-world data on tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), especially in patients with advanced renal impairment, are scarce. We evaluated its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness versus entecavir (ETV) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and pre-existing chronic kidney disease (CKD). In this retrospective single-centre study, CHB patients with pre-existing CKD treated with TAF or ETV were included. The primary outcome was change in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) over 48 weeks. Secondary outcomes included virological, biochemical and metabolic responses. Exploratory subgroup analyses were performed by CKD stage and dialysis status. Among 54 patients (35 TAF, 19 ETV), renal function remained stable in both groups. eGFR change from baseline to week 48 was not significantly different between the TAF and ETV groups (1.56 ± 8.14 vs. -0.53 ± 9.78 mL/min/1.73 m2; Δchange, 2.09; 95% CI, -0.35 to 7.68; p = 0.46). Both groups achieved sustained viral suppression, with no significant difference in undetectable HBV DNA in week-48. HBsAg reduction was greater with TAF than with ETV (-0.36 ± 0.42 vs. 0.02 ± 0.34 log10 IU/mL; p = 0.01). Exploratory analyses in patients with eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, TAF showed effective viral suppression and renal safety regardless of dialysis status. Metabolic parameters remained stable, without complex dose adjustments. TAF was safe and effective in CHB patients with CKD, including those with advanced renal impairment. Its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness did not differ significantly from those of ETV, with the practical advantage of fixed dosing without complex adjustment.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于替诺福韦艾拉酚胺(TAF)的现实世界数据,尤其是在肾功能严重受损的患者中,仍然非常有限。我们评估了TAF与恩替卡韦(ETV)在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)合并已有慢性肾脏病(CKD)患者中的肾脏安全性及有效性。本研究为一项回顾性单中心研究,纳入了接受TAF或ETV治疗的CHB合并已有CKD的患者。主要结局是48周内估算肾小球滤过率(eGFR)的变化。次要结局包括病毒学、生化和代谢反应。通过CKD阶段和透析状态进行了探索性亚组分析。在54名患者(35名接受TAF治疗,19名接受ETV治疗)中,两个组的肾功能均保持稳定。从基线到第48周,TAF组与ETV组的eGFR变化无显著差异(1.56 ± 8.14 vs. -0.53 ± 9.78 mL/min/1.73 m2;变化差值,2.09;95%置信区间,-0.35至7.68;p = 0.46)。两个组均实现了持续病毒抑制,第48周时检测不到HBV DNA无显著差异。TAF组的HBsAg下降幅度大于ETV组(-0.36 ± 0.42 vs. 0.02 ± 0.34 log10 IU/mL;p = 0.01)。在eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2的患者中,无论是否接受透析,TAF均表现出有效的病毒抑制和肾脏安全性。代谢参数保持稳定,无需复杂的剂量调整。TAF在CKD合并CHB患者中是安全且有效的,包括那些肾功能严重受损的患者。其肾脏安全性和有效性与ETV相比无显著差异,且具有固定剂量无需复杂调整的实用性优势。

papers.title: Inarigivir exhibits RIG-I-independent antiviral activity against HBV DNA replication in vitro by inhibiting viral polymerase activity
papers.abstract: Inarigivir (SB 9200) is a linear dinucleotide antiviral drug designed to act as a RIG-I agonist, activating cellular innate immune responses. Clinical trials in hepatitis C virus (HCV) patients have confirmed the innate immune-activating antiviral activity of Inarigivir. In hepatitis B virus (HBV) patients, clinical trials using Inarigivir have demonstrated significant reductions in HBV DNA and RNA levels, although heterogeneous drug-induced liver injury has been observed at higher doses. To further explore Inarigivir's mechanism of action against HBV, we characterized its antiviral effect in various hepatocyte-derived cell lines, including transiently transfected HepG2 and Huh7 cells, inducible HBV stable cell lines HepAD38 and HepDES19, and HBV-infected human hepatocytes. Our results show that Inarigivir inhibits HBV DNA replication in a dose-dependent manner without affecting HBV RNA levels or pgRNA encapsidation. HBV RNA immunoprecipitation assays revealed that Inarigivir does not affect viral polymerase binding to pgRNA, while the in vitro endogenous polymerase reaction (EPR) assays demonstrated that Inarigivir inhibits HBV DNA synthesis catalyzed by polymerase within the capsid. Additionally, we provided several lines of evidence indicating that Inarigivir's antiviral effect is independent of the RIG-I signalling pathway in hepatocyte-derived cells. Taken together, our study demonstrates a RIG-I-independent antiviral mechanism of Inarigivir by inhibiting HBV DNA replication as a dinucleosidic non-chain-terminating reverse transcriptase inhibitor.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the mechanism of action of Inarigivir against hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA replication, building on its established antiviral activity against hepatitis C virus (HCV).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study characterized Inarigivir's antiviral effect in hepatocyte-derived cell lines, including transiently transfected HepG2 and Huh7 cells, inducible HBV stable cell lines HepAD38 and HepDES19, and HBV-infected human hepatocytes.
analysis.methods: HBV RNA immunoprecipitation assays and in vitro endogenous polymerase reaction (EPR) assays were used to assess the effect of Inarigivir on viral polymerase binding to pgRNA and DNA synthesis catalyzed by polymerase within the capsid.
analysis.main_results: Inarigivir inhibited HBV DNA replication in a dose-dependent manner without affecting HBV RNA levels or pgRNA encapsidation. HBV RNA immunoprecipitation assays revealed no effect on viral polymerase binding to pgRNA, while EPR assays demonstrated inhibition of HBV DNA synthesis catalyzed by polymerase within the capsid.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that Inarigivir's antiviral effect against HBV is independent of the RIG-I signalling pathway, highlighting a novel mechanism of action as a dinucleosidic non-chain-terminating reverse transcriptase inhibitor.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the development of new therapeutic strategies for HBV infection, particularly for targeting DNA replication without relying on innate immune pathways.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro analyses, and the evidence is based on cell line models, which may not fully represent human liver physiology. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of clinical trial data on the mechanism of action.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the mechanism of action of Inarigivir against HBV DNA replication, building on its known antiviral activity against HCV. Using hepatocyte-derived cell lines, the research demonstrates that Inarigivir inhibits HBV DNA synthesis without affecting RNA levels or polymerase binding to pgRNA. The findings suggest a RIG-I-independent antiviral mechanism, highlighting its potential as a novel therapeutic agent for HBV. However, the study is limited to in vitro analyses, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of clinical data on this mechanism. The results may inform future research on HBV treatment strategies that target DNA replication directly.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为开发针对 HBV 感染的新治疗策略提供了见解,特别是在不依赖先天免疫途径的情况下靶向 DNA 复制。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外分析,证据基于细胞系模型,可能无法完全代表人类肝脏生理学。由于缺乏作用机制的临床试验数据,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: Inarigivir (SB 9200) 是一种线性二核苷酸 免疫应答 药物,设计用作 RIG-I 激动剂,激活细胞固有的 免疫应答。丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 患者的临床试验已证实 Inarigivir 具有先天免疫激活 抗病毒药物 活性。在 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 患者中,使用 Inarigivir 的临床试验已证明 HBV DNA 和 RNA 水平显着降低,尽管在较高剂量下观察到异质性药物引起的肝损伤。为了进一步探讨 Inarigivir 抗 HBV 的作用机制,我们表征了其 抗病毒药物 在各种肝细胞来源的细胞系中的作用,包括瞬时转染的 HepG2 和 Huh7 细胞、诱导型 HBV 稳定细胞系 HepAD38 和 HepDES19 以及 HBV 感染的人肝细胞。我们的结果表明,Inarigivir 以剂量依赖性方式抑制 HBV DNA 复制,而不影响 HBV RNA 水平或 pgRNA 衣壳化。HBV RNA 免疫沉淀试验显示 Inarigivir 不影响病毒聚合酶与 pgRNA 的结合,而体外内源聚合酶反应 (EPR) 试验表明 Inarigivir 抑制衣壳内聚合酶催化的 HBV DNA 合成。此外,我们提供了几条证据,表明 Inarigivir 的 抗病毒药物 作用独立于肝细胞衍生细胞中的 RIG-I 信号通路。综上所述,我们的研究证明了 Inarigivir 作为双核苷非链终止逆转录酶抑制剂抑制 HBV DNA 复制,具有独立于 RIG-I 的 抗病毒药物 机制。

papers.title: Hepatitis B Vaccination Coverage and Factors Associated with Vaccine Uptake Among Dental Healthcare Workers in Shimonoseki, Japan
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Dental healthcare workers (DHWs) are at high risk of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection due to occupational exposure. Although hepatitis B (HB) vaccination is recommended in Japan, vaccination coverage and factors associated with vaccine uptake remain unclear. This study aimed to clarify HB vaccination coverage, identify factors associated with vaccine uptake, and explore reasons for non-vaccination among DHWs in Shimonoseki, Japan. Methods: A cross-sectional web-based survey was conducted among 470 DHWs affiliated with the Shimonoseki Dental Association. Data on demographics, HBV/hepatitis C virus (HCV) testing, needlestick injuries, vaccination status, and reasons for non-vaccination were collected. Exploratory unadjusted group differences were analyzed using Chi-square or Fisher’s exact tests. Results: Of the 470 DHWs invited, 66 participated (response rate, 14.0%). Among respondents, 50.0% had a history of HB vaccination; however, only 22.7% had completed the three-dose series. Completion was significantly lower among dental staff than dentists (6.3% vs. Vaccination was associated with HBV-related education (p < 0.001), HBV/HCV testing history (HBV p < 0.001; HCV p < 0.001), and institutional policies (p = 0.0363), but not with needlestick injuries. Among the 27 unvaccinated respondents, the most frequently reported reason for non-vaccination was lack of personal recommendation. Conclusions: Among respondents, self-reported three-dose HB vaccination completion was low, particularly among dental staff. Vaccination status was associated with educational exposure, previous HBV/HCV testing, and reported workplace vaccination policies, whereas no association with self-reported needlestick injury history was observed.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:牙科保健工作者 (DHW) 由于职业暴露而面临 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染的高风险。尽管乙型肝炎 (HB) 疫苗接种 在日本得到推荐,但 疫苗接种 的覆盖范围和与 疫苗 摄取相关的因素仍不清楚。本研究旨在澄清 HB 疫苗接种 覆盖率,确定与 疫苗 吸收相关的因素,并探讨日本下关地区 DHW 中非 疫苗接种 的原因。方法:对下关牙科协会下属的 470 名 DHW 进行了一项横断面网络调查。收集了有关人口统计、HBV/丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 检测、针刺伤、疫苗接种 状态以及非 疫苗接种 原因的数据。使用卡方或费舍尔精确检验分析探索性未调整的组间差异。结果:在受邀的 470 名生活卫生工作者中,有 66 名参与(回应率为 14.0%)。受访者中,50.0%有HB 疫苗接种病史;然而,只有 22.7% 完成了三剂系列。牙科工作人员的完成率显着低于牙医(6.3% vs. 疫苗接种)与 HBV 相关教育 (p < 0.001)、HBV/HCV 检测史 (HBV p < 0.001;HCV p < 0.001) 和机构政策 (p = 0.0363) 相关,但与针刺伤无关。在 27 名未接种疫苗的受访者中,最常报告的原因是结论:在受访者中,自我报告的三剂 HB 疫苗接种 完成率较低,特别是在牙科工作人员中,疫苗接种 状态与教育程度、既往 HBV/HCV 检测和报告的工作场所 疫苗接种 政策相关,但未观察到与自我报告的针刺伤史相关。

papers.title: Hepatitis B vaccination coverage among Indian dental students – Systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Objective To estimate the pooled estimates of hepatitis B vaccination (HBV) coverage among Indian dental students. Methods This systematic review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines. The protocol was registered in PROSPERO. A systematic search was conducted in PubMed (1946 onward), CINAHL (1937 onward), Dentistry and Oral Sciences Source (journal-specific coverage), Embase (1947 onward), Web of Science (1900 onward), and Scopus (1970 onward) till July 1st, 2025. Cross-sectional studies conducted among Indian dental students that reported HBV coverage and studies reported in English were included. The meta-analysis was performed via OpenMeta [Analyst] (random effects model with the restricted maximum likelihood method). Results A total of 24 studies that reported the HBV were included. (total sample: 8740 (age range: 18–27 years). The pooled estimate of complete HBV coverage was 53.9% (95%CI: 41.84, 65.97), with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 99.7). Monitoring of the antibody titer was reported in only 5 studies ( n = 504). Egger's regression revealed no publication bias (Z = 1.73; P = 0.08). Meta-regression revealed no significant effect of age or sex distribution on the estimates of HBV coverage. However, studies on clinical dental students reported higher estimates than studies that combined preclinical and clinical students (coefficient: 0.37; P < 0.01). Conclusion Approximately half of the dental students had not completed the three-dose HBV.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to estimate the pooled hepatitis B vaccination (HBV) coverage among Indian dental students. The study included 24 studies with a total sample of 8740 students aged 18–27 years. The pooled estimate of complete HBV coverage was 53.9% (95%CI: 41.84, 65.97), with high heterogeneity. Only 5 studies (n = 504) reported monitoring of antibody titer, and studies on clinical dental students showed higher coverage than those combining preclinical and clinical students. The authors concluded that approximately half of the dental students had not completed the three-dose HBV. The findings suggest the need for targeted vaccination programs and public health initiatives to improve HBV coverage. However, the evidence strength is moderate due to high heterogeneity and limited monitoring of antibody titer.

papers.title: Serology-Anchored Comparison of Self-Reported Vaccination: Reported Hepatitis B Series Completion Exceeds Vaccine-Consistent Immunity in the Same Participants
papers.abstract: A large secondary literature draws adult vaccination status from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), whose accuracy is rarely quantified alongside it. The objective of this article is to quantify that accuracy in the same participants, because its size and direction decide whether these items can support a coverage claim. The methods we used pooled ten NHANES cycles (1999–2018, adults ≥ 20 years; analytic n 13,992–48,959 by vaccine) and compared self-reported, completed-series uptake with a within-person biological reference. That reference exists for hepatitis B in 2015–2016 only and does not validate the hepatitis A or human papillomavirus (HPV) estimates. Our results are that among the 4473 respondents with both measures, self-reported vaccination rates (33.5%, 95% CI: 30.5–36.5%) stood 10.9 percentage points (7.5–14.3) above vaccine-consistent serology (22.6%, 19.9–25.2%), a ratio of 1.48 (1.30–1.67). They disagreed in both directions, 845 reporting the series without the serologic profile and 294 carrying the profile without reporting it, so the difference is not a measure of over-reporting. Tested directly, it was a near-constant multiple across sex, age, and race. Published National Health Interview Survey coverage, matched on dose definition, population, and year, gave ratios up to 3.00. Four adjusted estimators placed the effect of a usual source of care at 5.7–6.5 percentage points for hepatitis B and 2.5–3.2 for HPV, three excluding zero and the causal forest’s wider interval covering it. The conclusions drawn are that the two measures are not interchangeable and that NHANES figures should be read as reported uptake, not coverage surveillance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to quantify the accuracy of self-reported vaccination status against hepatitis B virus in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), as this data is frequently used but rarely validated.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study pooled ten NHANES cycles (1999–2018) focusing on adults aged ≥ 20 years, with an analytic sample size of 13,992–48,959 by vaccine, and compared self-reported vaccination with biological serology data.
analysis.methods: The methods involved comparing self-reported vaccination rates with biological serology data for hepatitis B, using a within-person reference to assess the accuracy of self-reported data.
analysis.main_results: Among 4473 respondents with both measures, self-reported vaccination rates (33.5%, 95% CI: 30.5–36.5%) were 10.9 percentage points (7.5–14.3) higher than vaccine-consistent serology (22.6%, 19.9–25.2%), with a ratio of 1.48 (1.30–1.67).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that the two measures are not interchangeable, and that NHANES figures should be interpreted as reported uptake rather than as coverage surveillance.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings caution against using self-reported vaccination data as a proxy for actual immunity, which has implications for public health surveillance and policy decisions regarding hepatitis B vaccination programs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study found that the discrepancy was consistent across sex, age, and race, suggesting a near-constant multiple, but the reference data was limited to 2015–2016, which may affect generalisability.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the accuracy of self-reported hepatitis B vaccination status in NHANES data by comparing it with biological serology results. It finds that self-reported rates significantly exceed serology-based estimates, indicating that NHANES data may not reliably reflect true vaccination coverage. The study highlights the importance of validating self-reported data with biological measures for accurate public health surveillance. However, the reference data was limited to a specific time period, which may affect the generalisability of the findings. The results suggest that self-reported vaccination should not be used interchangeably with biological immunity data, and that policy decisions should account for this discrepancy.

papers.abstract_zh: 大量二手文献从国家健康和营养检查调查 (NHANES) 中提取了成人 疫苗接种 状态,但其准确性很少与之一起量化。本文的目的是量化同一参与者的准确性,因为其大小和方向决定这些项目是否可以支持承保索赔。我们使用的方法汇总了 10 个 NHANES 周期(1999-2018 年,成人 ≥ 20 岁;疫苗 分析 n 13,992-48,959),并将自我报告的完整系列吸收与人体内生物学参考进行比较。该参考仅适用于 2015-2016 年的乙型肝炎,并不能验证甲型肝炎或人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的估计值。我们的结果是,在采用这两种措施的 4473 名受访者中,自我报告的 疫苗接种 比率(33.5%,95% CI:30.5–36.5%)比 疫苗 一致的 血清学(22.6%,19.9–25.2%)高出 10.9 个百分点(7.5–14.3),比率为1.48(1.30–1.67)。他们在两个方向上都存在分歧,845 人报告了该系列但没有血清学特征,294 人携带了特征但没有报告,因此差异并不是过度报告的衡量标准。经过直接测试,该倍数在性别、年龄和种族中几乎恒定。已发布的国家健康访谈调查覆盖范围与剂量定义、人口和年份相匹配,给出的比率高达 3.00。四位调整后的估计者将常规护理来源对乙型肝炎的影响定为 5.7-6.5 个百分点,对 HPV 的影响为 2.5-3.2 个百分点,其中三位排除了零和因果森林覆盖它的更广泛区间。得出的结论是,这两种衡量标准不可互换,并且 NHANES 数据应解读为报告的采用率,而不是覆盖率 监测。

papers.title: Hepatitis B and C Screening Coverage among High-risk Populations in Saudi Arabia: A National Analysis of Surveillance Data and Alignment with the World Health Organization Viral Hepatitis Elimination Targets (2016–2023)
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Viral hepatitis B and C represent major global public health challenges, collectively responsible for approximately 1.1 million deaths annually. Saudi Arabia has historically demonstrated endemic hepatitis B transmission and carries a significant hepatitis C burden, yet comprehensive analyses of screening coverage among high-risk populations remain limited. Objectives: The objectives of the study were to characterize hepatitis B and C screening coverage patterns among high-risk populations in Saudi Arabia and evaluate alignment with the World Health Organization (WHO) Global Health Sector Strategy (GHSS) targets for viral hepatitis elimination by 2030. Materials and Methods: This cross-sectional descriptive study analyzed secondary data from the WHO Global Health Observatory estimates, Saudi Ministry of Health surveillance reports, and published epidemiological surveys (2016–2023). Screening coverage was assessed among defined high-risk groups including healthcare workers, blood donors, prisoners, patients on hemodialysis, and pregnant women. Descriptive statistics, including 95% confidence intervals (CIs), characterized coverage patterns by population group, geographic region, and temporal trends. Comparative analysis assessed alignment with the WHO GHSS targets. Results: Overall hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) testing coverage among high-risk populations reached 74.3% (95% CI: 74.2–74.4) in 2023, while anti-hepatitis C virus (HCV) testing coverage reached 68.9% (95% CI: 68.8–69.0). Blood donor screening achieved near-universal coverage (99.8%, 95% CI: 99.79–99.81, for both HBsAg and anti-HCV). Healthcare worker screening demonstrated 81.4% (95% CI: 81.3–81.5) HBsAg and 76.2% (95% CI: 76.0–76.4) anti-HCV coverage. Hemodialysis patient screening reached 94.7% (95% CI: 94.4–95.0) for HBsAg. Antenatal screening for HBsAg achieved 89.3% (95% CI: 89.2–89.4) nationally. However, prisoner screening remained lowest at 41.2% (95% CI: 40.8–41.6) for HBsAg and 38.7% (95% CI: 38.4–39.0) for anti-HCV. Regional disparities persisted, with border regions demonstrating 15–22 percentage point gaps below national averages. Temporal analysis revealed a modest improvement from 61.4% (95% CI: 61.3–61.5) in 2016 to 74.3% (95% CI: 74.2–74.4) in 2023 for HBsAg screening overall. Conclusions: Saudi Arabia has achieved strong screening coverage in clinical high-risk groups, but critical gaps persist among incarcerated populations and in border regions. Targeted expansion of screening programs, integration with primary health care, and strengthened linkage to care are essential to achieve the WHO 2030 viral hepatitis elimination targets.
papers.journal: Journal of Nature and Science of Medicine

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: Viral hepatitis B and C represent major global public health challenges, collectively responsible for approximately 1.1 million deaths annually. The study aimed to address the lack of comprehensive analyses on screening coverage among high-risk populations in Saudi Arabia.
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面描述性研究分析了来自世界卫生组织全球卫生观察站估计、沙特卫生部 监测 报告以及已发布的流行病学调查(2016-2023 年)的二手数据。该研究重点关注医护人员、献血者、囚犯、血液透析患者和孕妇等高危人群。
elements_zh.methods: 描述性统计数据,包括 95% 置信区间 (CI),按人口组、地理区域和时间趋势描述了覆盖模式。Comparative analysis assessed alignment with the WHO GHSS targets.
elements_zh.main_results: 2023年,高危人群乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)检测总体覆盖率达到74.3%(95% CI:74.2-74.4),丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)检测覆盖率达到68.9%(95% CI:68.8-69.0)。献血者筛查几乎实现了全民覆盖(HBsAg 和抗 HCV 均为 99.8%,95% CI:99.79–99.81)。医护人员筛查显示 HBsAg 覆盖率为 81.4%(95% CI:81.3–81.5),抗 HCV 覆盖率为 76.2%(95% CI:76.0–76.4)。血液透析患者的 HBsAg 筛查达到 94.7%(95% CI:94.4–95.0)。全国 HBsAg 产前筛查率达到 89.3%(95% CI:89.2–89.4)。然而,囚犯的 HBsAg 筛查率仍然最低,为 41.2%(95% CI:40.8–41.6),抗 HCV 筛查率为 38.7%(95% CI:38.4–39.0)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,沙特阿拉伯在临床高危人群中实现了强大的筛查覆盖率,但在被监禁人群和边境地区仍然存在严重差距。这项研究对符合世卫组织消除目标的筛查覆盖率进行了全国分析,强调了有针对性的干预措施的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要有针对性地扩大筛查计划、与初级卫生保健相结合,并加强与护理的联系,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除病毒性肝炎的目标。他们还强调了解决地区差异和改善弱势群体筛查的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于二手数据,不包括直接测量或干预措施。证据强度中等,因为结果来自描述性统计和现有报告的比较分析。

papers.title: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen and Hepatitis D Antibody Positivity among Inmates of Jos Correctional Centre, Plateau State, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis D virus (HDV) share transmission pathways, and ongoing HDV replication requires HBV surface antigen. Evidence from correctional facilities in Nigeria remains limited. This study assessed hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and anti-HDV antibody positivity among inmates of Jos Correctional Centre. Methods: In a cross-sectional serological survey, plasma samples from 235 incarcerated participants was tested for HBsAg using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). HBsAg-reactive samples were subsequently tested for anti-HDV antibodies by ELISA. Descriptive frequencies and Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated; Fisher’s exact test was used for selected sex- and exposure-stratified HBsAg comparisons. Results: HBsAg was detected in 43 of 235 participants (18.3%; 95% CI: 13.9–23.7%). Five of the 43 HBsAg-positive participants were anti-HDV positive (11.6%; 95% CI: 5.1–24.5%). HBsAg positivity was 42/227 (18.5%) among men and 1/8 (12.5%) among women (Fisher’s exact p = 1.00). Anti-HDV positivity occurred in five men and no women; only one HBsAg-positive woman was screened for anti-HDV. Small subgroup counts precluded reliable risk-factor inference. Conclusion: HBsAg and anti-HDV antibody positivity were observed in this correctional population. The findings support access to HBV screening, vaccination of susceptible individuals, HDV testing after HBsAg detection, and linkage to clinical assessment. Anti-HDV positivity alone does not establish active HDV infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 共享 传播 途径,并且持续的 HDV 复制需要 HBV 表面抗原。来自尼日利亚惩教设施的证据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究评估了乔斯惩教中心囚犯的乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 和抗 HDV 抗体阳性情况。235 名参与者中有 43 名检测到 HBsAg(18.3%;95% CI:13.9–23.7%)。
elements_zh.methods: 在一项横断面血清学调查中,使用酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 对 235 名被监禁参与者的血浆样本进行了 HBsAg 检测。随后通过 ELISA 检测 HBsAg 反应性样本的抗 HDV 抗体。计算描述频率和 Wilson 95% 置信区间 (CI);Fisher 精确检验用于选定的性别和暴露分层 HBsAg 比较。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在该矫正人群中观察到 HBsAg 和抗 HDV 抗体阳性。仅抗 HDV 阳性并不能确定活动性 HDV 感染。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持进行 HBV 筛查、易感个体的 疫苗接种、HBsAg 检测后的 HDV 检测以及与临床评估的联系。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 较小的亚组计数排除了可靠的风险因素推断。由于该研究受到横断面设计和小样本量的限制,因此证据是中等的。

papers.title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver and antiviral response in chronic hepatitis B: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) frequently coexists with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its association with antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB remains unclear. AIM To systematically evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB. METHODS This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science were searched for studies published up to November 30, 2025. Meta-analyses were performed to assess associations between MAFLD and antiviral treatment responses or clinical outcomes. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to evaluate robustness. RESULTS Thirty-two studies were included, of which 20 evaluated antiviral treatment efficacy and 13 assessed clinical outcomes in patients with CHB and concomitant MAFLD (one study reported both treatment responses and clinical outcomes). MAFLD was associated with a higher rate of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at 48 weeks [odds ratio (OR) = 1.41, 95%CI: 1.28-1.55], although this association was attenuated at 96 weeks (OR = 1.44, 95%CI: 0.96-2.16). No significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point. MAFLD was consistently associated with lower rates of alanine aminotransferase normalization and hepatitis B virus DNA clearance throughout the treatment duration. MAFLD was associated with a significantly increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy (OR = 1.50, 95%CI: 1.01-2.24). Subgroup analyses according to the antiviral regimen revealed distinct patterns, partly explaining the heterogeneity in the overall analyses. Subgroup analyses suggested that the antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. CONCLUSION MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and higher odds of HCC in patients with CHB, but not with hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance. These findings support metabolic risk assessment in CHB management and highlight the need for standardized MAFLD/metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease definitions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在评估 MAFLD 对 抗病毒药物 治疗 反应和 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者长期临床结果的影响。核心问题是 MAFLD 是否影响 CHB 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学、生化和临床反应。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次系统评价和荟萃分析遵循 PRISMA 指南。证据基础包括来自 PubMed、Cochrane 图书馆、EMBASE 和 Web of Science 的截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日发表的研究。基于 抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法进行亚组分析,并进行留一敏感性分析以评估研究结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

papers.title: Negatively Impacting Factors Against Effective Hepatitis B Vaccination
papers.abstract: Introduction : Infection by the Hepatitis B virus is one of the greatest global public health issues. One study revealed that the world is facing about 3.61% of the overall HBV infection burden, with significant variation across countries. This study explores the negatively influencing factors that are hampering the effective Hepatitis-B vaccination. Methods: A review of the published studies that were written on the factors that hamper successful hepatitis B vaccination was conducted using the Google Scholar search engine. A total of 26 journal articles on negatively influencing factors of hepatitis B vaccination were studied, and the most relevant items during the last 10 years were identified and analyzed. Results: Overall, 18 barriers have been identified that hinder the effective uptake of hepatitis B vaccines. Those are lack of appropriate awareness and knowledge about Hepatitis B viral vaccination was identified as by far the highest factor and was 69% (18), simultaneiously, not having adequate education among parents is mentioned in more than 41% (11) of studies, followed by superstition and false perception or belief regarding vaccination as well as cultural barriers are also mentioned by 36% (9) of studies. On the other hand, the price of the vaccine and the unavailability of the vaccine are mentioned in 27% (7) of the reviewed articles. The fourth most mentioned barrier was lack of awareness among the health providers, along with inadequate knowledge of HBV among healthcare professionals, which was mentioned by 15% (4) of the reviewed studies. Issues differed from region to region. Conclusion: An appropriately planned and well-organized hepatitis B vaccination policy throughout the nation should be emphasized and prioritized to have adequate vaccine coverage after identifying the negatively influencing factors, and controlling those factors to eradicate the hepatitis B virus from the era. Medicine Today 2026, Vol.38 (2): 324-328

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the factors that negatively impact the effectiveness of hepatitis B vaccination. The central question is to identify the barriers that hinder the uptake of hepatitis B vaccines and to explore how these factors influence vaccination outcomes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review was conducted using the Google Scholar search engine to gather published studies on the factors that hamper successful hepatitis B vaccination. A total of 26 journal articles were studied, with the most relevant items from the last 10 years being identified and analyzed.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identified 18 barriers that hinder the effective uptake of hepatitis B vaccines. Lack of awareness and knowledge about Hepatitis B vaccination was the highest factor, cited in 69% (18) of the studies. Inadequate education among parents was mentioned in 41% (11) of the studies, while superstition and false perceptions about vaccination were noted in 36% (9) of the studies. The price and unavailability of the vaccine were mentioned in 27% (7) of the reviewed articles. The review also highlights that issues differ by region.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the barriers to effective hepatitis B vaccination vary significantly across regions, indicating a lack of uniformity in the challenges faced. There is no explicit mention of specific regions or populations where these barriers are most prevalent, which represents an evidence gap.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for an appropriately planned and well-organized hepatitis B vaccination policy to ensure adequate vaccine coverage. It suggests that addressing the identified barriers, such as improving awareness and education, is crucial for eradicating the hepatitis B virus.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the factors that negatively impact the effectiveness of hepatitis B vaccination. It identifies 18 barriers, with lack of awareness and knowledge being the most significant. The review highlights the importance of addressing these barriers through targeted policies and education to improve vaccine coverage and ultimately eradicate the virus. The findings suggest that regional differences in these challenges exist, indicating a need for localized strategies. The review was conducted using Google Scholar and included 26 journal articles from the last decade, emphasizing the necessity of well-organized vaccination programs.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注对乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 有效性产生负面影响的因素。核心问题是确定阻碍乙型肝炎 疫苗 吸收的障碍,并探讨这些因素如何影响 疫苗接种 结果。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查是使用 Google Scholar 搜索引擎收集已发表的有关阻碍乙型肝炎成功的因素的研究 疫苗接种 进行的。总共研究了 26 篇期刊文章,识别并分析了过去 10 年中最相关的文章。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查确定了阻碍乙型肝炎 疫苗 有效吸收的 18 种障碍。缺乏对乙型肝炎的认识和知识 疫苗接种 是最重要的因素,在 69% (18) 的研究中被引用。41% (11) 的研究提到了家长教育不足的问题,而 36% (9) 的研究提到了对疫苗接种 的迷信和错误认知。27% (7) 的评论文章提到了 疫苗 的价格和可用性。审查还强调,问题因地区而异。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要制定适当计划和组织良好的乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 政策,以确保足够的 疫苗 覆盖范围。它表明,解决已发现的障碍,例如提高意识和教育,对于根除 乙型肝炎病毒 至关重要。

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:乙型肝炎病毒 感染是全球最严重的公共卫生问题之一。一项研究显示,全球正面临约 3.61% 的乙型肝炎病毒感染负担,不同国家之间存在显着差异。本研究探讨了阻碍有效乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的负面影响因素。方法:使用 Google Scholar 搜索引擎对已发表的关于阻碍乙型肝炎成功的因素 疫苗接种 的研究进行了回顾。总共研究了 26 篇关于乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 负面影响因素的期刊文章,并确定并分析了过去 10 年中最相关的文章。结果:总体而言,已确定 18 种障碍阻碍乙型肝炎 疫苗 的有效摄取。对乙型肝炎病毒 疫苗接种 缺乏适当的认识和知识被认为是迄今为止最高的因素,占 69% (18),同时,超过 41% (11) 的研究提到父母没有接受足够的教育,其次是 36% (9) 的研究提到对 疫苗接种 的迷信和错误看法或信仰以及文化障碍。另一方面,27% (7) 的评论文章提到了 疫苗 的价格和 疫苗 的不可用。第四个最常提到的障碍是医疗保健提供者缺乏认识,以及医疗保健专业人员对乙型肝炎病毒的了解不足,15% (4) 的审查研究提到了这一点。问题因地区而异。结论:在查明负面影响因素并控制这些因素后,应强调并优先在全国范围内制定适当规划和组织良好的乙型肝炎疫苗接种政策,以实现足够的疫苗覆盖范围,并控制这些因素,以从时代消除乙型肝炎病毒。今日医学 2026 年,第 38 卷 (2):324-328

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注对乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 有效性产生负面影响的因素。核心问题是确定阻碍乙型肝炎 疫苗 吸收的障碍,并探讨这些因素如何影响 疫苗接种 结果。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查是使用 Google Scholar 搜索引擎收集已发表的有关阻碍乙型肝炎成功的因素的研究 疫苗接种 进行的。总共研究了 26 篇期刊文章,识别并分析了过去 10 年中最相关的文章。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查确定了阻碍乙型肝炎 疫苗 有效吸收的 18 种障碍。缺乏对乙型肝炎的认识和知识 疫苗接种 是最重要的因素,在 69% (18) 的研究中被引用。41% (11) 的研究提到了家长教育不足的问题,而 36% (9) 的研究提到了对疫苗接种 的迷信和错误认知。27% (7) 的评论文章提到了 疫苗 的价格和可用性。审查还强调,问题因地区而异。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查指出,有效乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的障碍在不同地区存在显着差异,表明所面临的挑战缺乏统一性。没有明确提及这些障碍最普遍的特定地区或人群,这代表了证据差距。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要制定适当计划和组织良好的乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 政策,以确保足够的 疫苗 覆盖范围。它表明,解决已发现的障碍,例如提高意识和教育,对于根除 乙型肝炎病毒 至关重要。

papers.title: Discovery of XT1061, a HBV Capsid Assembly Modulator, as a Promising Therapeutic Candidate for Clinical Treatment of HBV Infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) persists as a major unresolved infectious disease. Patients typically require lifelong administration of nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) or interferons but seldom achieve functional cure. Recent studies indicate that HBV core assembly modulators (CAMs), when combined with NAs and interferons, can more effectively reduce HBsAg in plasma, thereby facilitating functional cure. In this research, we discovered compound 39 (designated XT1061) through structural optimization of previously reported GLP-26, which exhibited potent anti-HBV activity in vitro (EC50 = 1.0 ± 0.1 nM). In the murine AAV/HBV model, XT1061 induced rapid reduction of HBV DNA and sustained viral DNA clearance throughout treatment. Notably, Combination therapy of XT1061 with pradefovir mesylate (PDV) exhibited significantly enhanced efficacy compared with monotherapy. Further preclinical evaluation and Phase I clinical trials (NCT06280534) confirmed that XT1061 possesses favorable drug-like properties and low safety risks. Collectively, XT1061 represents a promising anti-HBV therapeutic candidate, providing a viable strategy for the clinical management of chronic HBV infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the need for effective therapeutic candidates for chronic HBV infection, given the limitations of current treatments which do not achieve functional cure.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research involved the discovery and evaluation of compound XT1061 in vitro and in a murine AAV/HBV model.
analysis.methods: XT1061 was identified through structural optimization of GLP-26 and tested for anti-HBV activity in vitro and in vivo.
analysis.main_results: XT1061 exhibited potent anti-HBV activity in vitro (EC50 = 1.0 ± 0.1 nM) and induced rapid reduction of HBV DNA in the murine AAV/HBV model, with sustained viral DNA clearance throughout treatment. Combination therapy with XT1061 and pradefovir mesylate showed significantly enhanced efficacy.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that XT1061 represents a promising therapeutic candidate for chronic HBV infection, with potential to facilitate functional cure when combined with other treatments.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that XT1061 could provide a viable strategy for the clinical management of chronic HBV infection, potentially leading to functional cure.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its preclinical nature and the need for further evaluation in larger, more diverse populations. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of human clinical trial data.

analysis.summary_en: This study discovered compound XT1061, a potent HBV capsid assembly modulator, which showed promising results in reducing HBV DNA in a murine model and in combination therapy with pradefovir mesylate. The findings suggest a potential new therapeutic strategy for chronic HBV infection.

papers.title_zh: XT1061(一种 HBV 衣壳组装调节剂)的发现,作为 HBV 感染的临床 治疗 有希望的治疗候选药物
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) persists as a major unresolved infectious disease. Patients typically require lifelong administration of nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) or interferons but seldom achieve functional cure. Recent studies indicate that HBV core assembly modulators (CAMs), when combined with NAs and interferons, can more effectively reduce HBsAg in plasma, thereby facilitating functional cure. In this research, we discovered compound 39 (designated XT1061) through structural optimization of previously reported GLP-26, which exhibited potent anti-HBV activity in vitro (EC50 = 1.0 ± 0.1 nM). In the murine AAV/HBV model, XT1061 induced rapid reduction of HBV DNA and sustained viral DNA clearance throughout treatment. Notably, Combination therapy of XT1061 with pradefovir mesylate (PDV) exhibited significantly enhanced efficacy compared with monotherapy. Further preclinical evaluation and Phase I clinical trials (NCT06280534) confirmed that XT1061 possesses favorable drug-like properties and low safety risks. Collectively, XT1061 represents a promising anti-HBV therapeutic candidate, providing a viable strategy for the clinical management of chronic HBV infection.

papers.title: Hepatitis B and C infections and risk of age related macular degeneration in a nationwide Korean cohort
papers.abstract: Abstract Evidence on viral hepatitis and age-related macular degeneration (AMD) remains limited, particularly from long-term prospective studies. We investigated whether hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections are associated with the subsequent development of AMD in a nationwide Korean cohort. Using National Health Insurance Service data, we included 12,386,563 adults aged ≥ 40 years who underwent health examinations in 2009–2010 and were followed through 2023. HBV and HCV infections were identified using diagnostic codes. Incident AMD was classified as exudative using Rare Intractable Disease registration codes and as nonexudative using Korean Classification of Diseases codes. During follow-up, 388,652 participants developed incident AMD. In multivariable Cox proportional hazards models, HBV infection was associated with increased risks of exudative AMD (hazard ratio [HR] 1.18, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.05–1.32) and nonexudative AMD (HR 1.68, 95% CI 1.60–1.76). HCV infection was also associated with increased risks of exudative AMD (HR 1.53, 95% CI 1.27–1.86) and nonexudative AMD (HR 1.41, 95% CI 1.27–1.57). Associations appeared stronger in women in sex-stratified analyses. HBV and HCV infections were associated with increased risks of both exudative and nonexudative AMD.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这一发现解释为表明 HBV 和 HCV 感染与渗出性和非渗出性 AMD 风险增加相关。这是一项将病毒性肝炎与 AMD 联系起来的新观察。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,病毒性肝炎感染可能会增加AMD的风险,这可以为未来的监测和肝炎高发人群的AMD预防策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖诊断代码来识别感染和 AMD,这可能会引入错误分类偏差。由于这些限制,证据是中等的。

papers.title: Chronic Hepatitis B and Steatotic Liver Disease: From Bidirectional Interaction to Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and steatotic liver disease (SLD) are among the most prevalent chronic liver diseases worldwide and increasingly coexist, particularly in regions where hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains endemic. Reported prevalence of hepatic steatosis in CHB varies widely, reflecting the diagnostic modality and population studied rather than a single underlying figure. Across series using liver biopsy, ultrasound or controlled attenuation parameter (CAP), hepatic steatosis in CHB is associated more consistently with host metabolic and genetic factors than with markers of viral replication. Hepatic steatosis is repeatedly associated with lower serum HBV DNA, lower quantitative hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), lower hepatitis B envelope antigen (HBeAg) positivity and a higher probability of HBsAg seroclearance. These virological associations do not consistently predict long-term liver outcomes, and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists after HBsAg seroclearance. Studies using hepatic steatosis as the exposure report inconsistent findings for HCC, with adjusted estimates ranging from inverse to strongly positive. Metabolic dysfunction shows a more consistent association with HCC, particularly diabetes, obesity and multiple concurrent cardiometabolic risk factors, and this association persists in virologically suppressed patients and after HBsAg seroclearance. Hepatic steatosis, metabolic dysfunction, steatohepatitis and fibrosis should therefore be assessed as distinct prognostic variables rather than as a single entity, with implications for HCC risk stratification and surveillance in CHB.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the relationship between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and steatotic liver disease (SLD), highlighting their coexistence in endemic regions. It reports that the prevalence of hepatic steatosis in CHB varies depending on diagnostic methods, and that steatosis is more consistently linked to host metabolic and genetic factors than viral replication markers. The findings indicate that virological associations with steatosis do not reliably predict long-term liver outcomes, and HCC risk remains even after HBsAg seroclearance. However, the study notes that findings on HCC risk associated with steatosis are inconsistent, with adjusted estimates ranging from inverse to strongly positive. The evidence is moderate, as the study relies on observational data and does not provide definitive causal conclusions.

papers.abstract_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 和脂肪肝病 (SLD) 是全球最常见的慢性肝病之一,并且越来越多地共存,特别是在 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然流行的地区。报道的慢性乙型肝炎肝脂肪变性的 患病率 差异很大,反映了诊断方式和研究的人群,而不是单一的基础数据。在使用肝活检、超声或受控衰减参数 (CAP) 的系列研究中,CHB 中的肝脂肪变性与 宿主 代谢和遗传因素的相关性比与病毒复制标志物的相关性更一致。肝脂肪变性反复与较低的血清 HBV DNA、较低的乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 定量、较低的乙型肝炎包膜抗原 (HBeAg) 阳性率以及较高的 HBsAg 血清清除概率相关。这些病毒学关联并不能一致地预测长期肝脏结果,并且 HBsAg 血清清除后肝细胞癌 (HCC) 风险仍然存在。使用肝脂肪变性作为暴露的研究报告了 HCC 的不一致结果,调整后的估计范围从反向到强正。代谢功能障碍与 HCC 存在更一致的关联,特别是糖尿病、肥胖和多种并发心脏代谢危险因素,并且这种关联在病毒学抑制的患者和 HBsAg 血清清除后持续存在。因此,肝脂肪变性、代谢功能障碍、脂肪性肝炎和纤维化应作为不同的预后变量而不是作为单一实体进行评估,这对 HCC 风险分层和 CHB 中的 监测 具有影响。

papers.title: CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis beyond programmed cell death protein 1 in hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma develops in a chronically inflamed, tolerogenic liver microenvironment. In this setting, T-cell dysfunction limits the efficacy of programmed death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Emerging evidence from Liu et al published in the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology suggests that CD161 may represent an additional inhibitory axis within exhausted CD8+ T cells that is not fully captured by the PD-1/ programmed death ligand-1 pathway. In their study, CD161+CD8+ T cells were enriched in tumor tissue, and CD161 expression persisted even as PD-1+ compartments contracted after PD-1 inhibition, suggesting that CD161-mediated restraint may remain active under therapeutic pressure. Mechanistically, sustained engagement of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 interaction may impair T-cell effector function and contribute to adaptive immune resistance in the HBV-infected liver. These findings highlight the importance of protein-level assessment of CD161 and parallel evaluation with PD-1 to accurately characterize immune inhibition. Key knowledge gaps include the cellular source of lectin-like transcript 1 within the tumor microenvironment, the influence of ongoing HBV virological activity on CD161+ T-cell subsets, and the identification of clinically meaningful progression endpoints. In this editorial, we place these findings in mechanistic and translational context, highlighting the potential role of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis as a complementary pathway of immune resistance beyond PD-1 blockade. Collectively, the current evidence supports a cautious, hypothesis-driven translational strategy to evaluate combined modulation of the CD161 and PD-1 axes in carefully selected patients with HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.

papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关肝细胞癌在慢性炎症、耐受性肝脏微环境中发生。在这种情况下,T 细胞功能障碍限制了程序性死亡 1 (PD-1) 阻断的功效。Liu 等人发表在《世界胃肠肿瘤学杂志》上的新证据表明,CD161 可能代表耗尽的 CD8+ T 细胞内的另一个抑制轴,该轴未被 PD-1/程序性死亡配体-1 通路完全捕获。在他们的研究中,CD161+CD8+T细胞在肿瘤组织中富集,即使PD-1+区室在PD-1抑制后收缩,CD161表达仍然持续,这表明CD161介导的抑制可能在治疗压力下保持活跃。从机制上讲,CD161-凝集素样转录物 1 相互作用的持续参与可能会损害 T 细胞效应器功能,并有助于 HBV 感染肝脏中的适应性免疫抵抗。这些发现强调了 CD161 蛋白质水平评估和 PD-1 平行评估对于准确表征免疫抑制的重要性。关键知识差距包括肿瘤微环境中凝集素样转录物 1 的细胞来源、持续的 HBV 病毒学活性对 CD161+ T 细胞亚群的影响,以及临床有意义的进展终点的识别。在这篇社论中,我们将这些发现置于机制和转化背景中,强调了 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴作为 PD-1 阻断之外的免疫抵抗的补充途径的潜在作用。总的来说,当前的证据支持谨慎的、假设驱动的转化策略,以评估精心挑选的 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者中 CD161 和 PD-1 轴的联合调节。

papers.title: Realizing personalized prediction for the reversal of chronic hepatitis B-associated liver fibrosis through machine learning
papers.abstract: Although long-term antiviral therapy can reverse liver fibrosis in a considerable proportion of patients with chronic hepatitis B, treatment response differs markedly among individuals, and reliable methods for predicting who will benefit remain lacking. Conventional clinical tools such as liver stiffness measurement and the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index were originally dewsigned for cross-sectional staging rather than longitudinal prediction, and their ability to capture the dynamic process of fibrosis reversal is limited. In this opinion review, we discuss how machine learning (ML) may help address this unmet need. We focus on three areas where ML has shown early but encouraging results: Quantitative analysis of images using ML, integration of pathological and clinical data through multimodal models, and dynamic prediction of treatment response based on serial measurements during antiviral therapy. In our view, the greatest value of ML lies not in replacing existing assessment tools but in complementing them, particularly through the early identification of patients who are unlikely to achieve fibrosis reversal with antiviral therapy alone. However, we also caution that most current models have been developed from small, single-center retrospective cohorts, and their clinical adoption will require prospective multi-center validation, improved model interpretability, and adherence to standardized reporting frameworks.

papers.abstract_zh: 尽管长期抗病毒药物治疗可以逆转慢性乙型肝炎患者的肝纤维化,但个体对治疗的反应差异显著,目前仍缺乏可靠的预测方法。传统的临床工具如肝硬度测量和天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶与血小板比值指数最初设计用于横断面分期,而非纵向预测,其捕捉纤维化逆转动态过程的能力有限。在本观点综述中,我们讨论了机器学习(ML)如何帮助解决这一未满足的需求。我们重点关注了机器学习在三个方面的早期但有希望的结果:利用机器学习进行图像的定量分析、通过多模态模型整合病理和临床数据,以及基于抗病毒药物治疗期间的连续测量动态预测治疗反应。我们认为,机器学习的最大价值并不在于取代现有评估工具,而在于补充它们,特别是在早期识别那些仅通过抗病毒药物治疗难以实现纤维化逆转的患者方面。然而,我们也提醒,目前大多数模型都是基于小规模、单中心的回顾性队列研究开发的,其临床应用需要前瞻性多中心验证、提高模型的可解释性以及遵循标准化的报告框架。

papers.title: Prevalence of hepatitis delta virus (HDV) among hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive blood donors followed at the Blood Donor Medical Follow-up Centre (CMSDS) in Cte dIvoire
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV) infection exacerbates hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related liver disease.In Côte d'Ivoire, HDV is systematic not systematically screened among hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)positive blood donors, and most regional estimates rely on anti-HDV serology, which indicates exposure but not active replication.This study aimed to determine HDV RNA replication positivity among HBsAgpositive blood donors followed at the Blood Donor Medical Follow-up Centre (CMSDS) of the National Blood Transfusion Centre of Côte d'Ivoire (CNTSCI), using nested reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR).A cross-sectional study based on a non-probability convenience sample was conducted in March 2021.HDV RNA was detected by nested RT-PCR targeting two genomic regions (nucleotides 888-1122 and 313-485).Of 51 donors included, 75% were male (n = 38) and and mean age was 37 ± 9 years.HBV DNA results were available for 43 donors (84%).Among them, HDV RNA positivity was 88.9% (32/36) in those with detectable HBV viraemia and 100% (7/7) in those with undetectable viral load, giving an overall positivity 90.7% (39/43).This figure applies only to donors with available viral load data not the entire cohort of 51 donors.HDV RNA was also detected in donors receiving tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) with suppressed HBV viraemia.Given the convenience sample of donors already in follow-up care, findings are hypothesis-generating rather than population-level estimates.These results support larger representative studies and systematic HDV screening during follow-up of individuals with chronic HBV infection.Key words: Hepatitis B virus/hepatitis delta virus (HBV/HDV) co-infection, nested reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), molecular epidemiology, convenience sample, transfusion medicine, West Africa.
papers.journal: International Journal of Genetics and Molecular Biology

papers.title: Pegylated interferon α-2b add-on to nucleos(t)ide analogues reduces hepatocellular carcinoma and decompensation in advanced fibrotic chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy.
analysis.methods: A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores.
analysis.main_results: The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that combination therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b may offer important benefits for reducing HCC and decompensation in high-risk HBV patients. This could inform future treatment strategies for managing advanced fibrosis and cirrhosis in chronic hepatitis B.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is a retrospective cohort study, which may introduce bias and confounding factors. The evidence is moderate as it relies on propensity score matching and stratified survival analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. A retrospective cohort study design was used, with patients divided into combination therapy and NA monotherapy groups. Propensity score matching was applied to balance baseline characteristics, and survival analysis was stratified by clinical features and HCC risk scores. The results showed that combination therapy significantly reduced the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis compared to monotherapy, with hazard ratios of 0.22 (95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and 0.39 (95%CI: 0.20-0.77), respectively. These benefits were most evident in intermediate-to-high risk patients and those with persistent biochemical abnormalities. The findings support the use of Peg-IFNα-2b add-on therapy in high-risk HBV patients, potentially informing future treatment strategies. However, the study's retrospective nature introduces limitations, and the evidence is moderate due to reliance on matching and stratified analysis.
